```kotlin
class BankService {
    private val users = mutableListOf<User>()
    private val transactions = mutableListOf<Transaction>()

    init {
        // Sample data
        val account1 = Account("123456789", "Checking", 5000.0, "USD")
        val account2 = Account("987654321", "Savings", 10000.0, "USD")
        val user = User("1", "John Doe", "john@example.com", "password", listOf(account1, account2))
        users.add(user)

        // Sample transactions
        transactions.add(Transaction("1", "2023-01-15", 200.0, "Deposit", "Salary", 5200.0))
        transactions.add(Transaction("2", "2023-01-10", -50.0, "Withdrawal", "Grocery", 4950.0))
    }

    fun authenticate(email: String, password: String): User? {
        return users.find { it.email == email && it.password == password }
    }

    fun getTransactions(accountNumber: String): List<Transaction> {
        return transactions.filter { it.id.startsWith(accountNumber.take(3)) }
    }

    fun transferMoney(fromAccount: String, toAccount: String, amount: Double): Boolean {
        val fromUser = users.find { user ->
            user.accounts.any { it.accountNumber == fromAccount }
        } ?: return false

        val toUser = users.find { user ->
            user.accounts.any { it.accountNumber == toAccount }
        } ?: return false

        val fromAccountObj = fromUser.accounts.find { it.accountNumber == fromAccount }!!
        val toAccountObj = toUser.accounts.find { it.accountNumber == toAccount }!!

        if (fromAccountObj.balance >= amount) {
            // Update balances
            val updatedFromAccounts = fromUser.accounts.map {
                if (it.accountNumber == fromAccount) it.copy(balance = it.balance - amount) else it
            }

            val updatedToAccounts = toUser.accounts.map {
                if (it.accountNumber == toAccount) it.copy(balance = it.balance + amount) else it
            }

            // Update users
            users.remove(fromUser)
            users.add(fromUser.copy(accounts = updatedFromAccounts))

            users.remove(toUser)
            users.add(toUser.copy(accounts = updatedToAccounts))

            // Add transaction records
            val transactionId = (transactions.size + 1).toString()
            transactions.add(
                Transaction(
                    transactionId,
                    "2023-01-20",
                    -amount,
                    "Transfer",
                    "To $toAccount",
                    fromAccountObj.balance - amount
                )
            )

            transactions.add(
                Transaction(
                    transactionId,
                    "2023-01-20",
                    amount,
                    "Transfer",
                    "From $fromAccount",
                    toAccountObj.balance + amount
                )
            )

            return true
        }
        return false
    }
}
```

```kotlin
class TransferActivity : AppCompatActivity() {
    private lateinit var binding: ActivityTransferBinding
    private val bankService = BankService()
    private lateinit var user: User

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        binding = ActivityTransferBinding.inflate(layoutInflater)
        setContentView(binding.root)

        val userId = intent.getStringExtra("USER_ID")
        user = bankService.users.find { it.id == userId }!!

        setupUI()
    }

    private fun setupUI() {
        // Populate from account spinner
        val fromAccounts = user.accounts.map { it.accountNumber }
        val fromAdapter = ArrayAdapter(this, android.R.layout.simple_spinner_item, fromAccounts)
        binding.fromAccountSpinner.adapter = fromAdapter

        binding.transferButton.setOnClickListener {
            val fromAccount = binding.fromAccountSpinner.selectedItem.toString()
            val toAccount = binding.toAccountEditText.text.toString()
            val amount = binding.amountEditText.text.toString().toDoubleOrNull()

            if (amount != null && amount > 0) {
                val success = bankService.transferMoney(fromAccount, toAccount, amount)
                if (success) {
                    Toast.makeText(this, "Transfer successful", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                    finish()
                } else {
                    Toast.makeText(this, "Transfer failed", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                }
            } else {
                Toast.makeText(this, "Invalid amount", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            }
        }
    }
}
```

### adapters/TransactionAdapter.kt
```kotlin
class TransactionAdapter(private val transactions: List<Transaction>) :
    RecyclerView.Adapter<TransactionAdapter.TransactionViewHolder>() {

    class TransactionViewHolder(val binding: ItemTransactionBinding) : RecyclerView.ViewHolder(binding.root)

    override fun onCreateViewHolder(parent: ViewGroup, viewType: Int): TransactionViewHolder {
        val binding = ItemTransactionBinding.inflate(
            LayoutInflater.from(parent.context),
            parent,
            false
        )
        return TransactionViewHolder(binding)
    }

    override fun onBindViewHolder(holder: TransactionViewHolder, position: Int) {
        val transaction = transactions[position]
        holder.binding.dateText.text = transaction.date
        holder.binding.descriptionText.text = transaction.description
        holder.binding.amountText.text = "${transaction.amount}"

        // Set color based on transaction type
        val color = if (transaction.amount > 0) {
            ContextCompat.getColor(holder.itemView.context, android.R.color.holo_green_dark)
        } else {
            ContextCompat.getColor(holder.itemView.context, android.R.color.holo_red_dark)
        }
        holder.binding.amountText.setTextColor(color)
    }

    override fun getItemCount() = transactions.size
}
```

```kotlin
package com.example.bankingapp

import android.content.Intent
import android.os.Bundle
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity
import com.example.bankingapp.activities.LoginActivity

class MainActivity : AppCompatActivity() {
    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        setContentView(R.layout.activity_main)

        // Check if user is logged in
        val sharedPref = getSharedPreferences("BankingAppPrefs", MODE_PRIVATE)
        val isLoggedIn = sharedPref.getBoolean("isLoggedIn", false)

        if (isLoggedIn) {
            // Navigate to dashboard if already logged in
            startActivity(Intent(this, DashboardActivity::class.java))
            finish()
        } else {
            // Navigate to login screen
            startActivity(Intent(this, LoginActivity::class.java))
            finish()
        }
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package com.example.bankingapp.activities

import android.content.Intent
import android.os.Bundle
import android.widget.Button
import android.widget.EditText
import android.widget.Toast
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity
import com.example.bankingapp.R
import com.example.bankingapp.services.AuthService

class LoginActivity : AppCompatActivity() {
    private lateinit var authService: AuthService

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        setContentView(R.layout.activity_login)

        authService = AuthService(this)

        val etUsername = findViewById<EditText>(R.id.etUsername)
        val etPassword = findViewById<EditText>(R.id.etPassword)
        val btnLogin = findViewById<Button>(R.id.btnLogin)

        btnLogin.setOnClickListener {
            val username = etUsername.text.toString()
            val password = etPassword.text.toString()

            if (username.isEmpty() || password.isEmpty()) {
                Toast.makeText(this, "Please fill all fields", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                return@setOnClickListener
            }

            if (authService.login(username, password)) {
                // Save login state
                val sharedPref = getSharedPreferences("BankingAppPrefs", MODE_PRIVATE)
                with(sharedPref.edit()) {
                    putBoolean("isLoggedIn", true)
                    putString("username", username)
                    apply()
                }

                // Navigate to dashboard
                startActivity(Intent(this, DashboardActivity::class.java))
                finish()
            } else {
                Toast.makeText(this, "Invalid credentials", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package com.example.bankingapp.activities

import android.content.Intent
import android.os.Bundle
import android.widget.Button
import android.widget.TextView
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity
import com.example.bankingapp.R
import com.example.bankingapp.models.Account
import com.example.bankingapp.services.AccountService

class DashboardActivity : AppCompatActivity() {
    private lateinit var accountService: AccountService
    private lateinit var currentAccount: Account

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        setContentView(R.layout.activity_dashboard)

        accountService = AccountService(this)

        // Get current user from shared preferences
        val sharedPref = getSharedPreferences("BankingAppPrefs", MODE_PRIVATE)
        val username = sharedPref.getString("username", "") ?: ""

        // Load account data
        currentAccount = accountService.getAccountByUsername(username)

        // Update UI
        val tvAccountName = findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tvAccountName)
        val tvAccountNumber = findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tvAccountNumber)
        val tvBalance = findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tvBalance)

        tvAccountName.text = currentAccount.accountName
        tvAccountNumber.text = "Account #: ${currentAccount.accountNumber}"
        tvBalance.text = "Balance: $${String.format("%.2f", currentAccount.balance)}"

        // Set up buttons
        val btnTransactions = findViewById<Button>(R.id.btnTransactions)
        val btnTransfer = findViewById<Button>(R.id.btnTransfer)
        val btnLogout = findViewById<Button>(R.id.btnLogout)

        btnTransactions.setOnClickListener {
            startActivity(Intent(this, TransactionsActivity::class.java))
        }

        btnTransfer.setOnClickListener {
            startActivity(Intent(this, TransferActivity::class.java))
        }

        btnLogout.setOnClickListener {
            // Clear login state
            val sharedPref = getSharedPreferences("BankingAppPrefs", MODE_PRIVATE)
            with(sharedPref.edit()) {
                putBoolean("isLoggedIn", false)
                remove("username")
                apply()
            }

            // Navigate back to login
            startActivity(Intent(this, LoginActivity::class.java))
            finish()
        }
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package com.example.bankingapp.services

import android.content.Context
import com.example.bankingapp.models.Account
import com.example.bankingapp.models.Transaction

class AccountService(private val context: Context) {
    // In a real app, this would connect to a database or API
    private val accounts = mutableListOf(
        Account("123456789", "John Doe", "john@example.com", 1000.00),
        Account("987654321", "Jane Smith", "jane@example.com", 5000.00)
    )

    private val transactions = mutableListOf(
        Transaction("123456789", "Deposit", 500.00, "2023-01-15"),
        Transaction("123456789", "Withdrawal", -200.00, "2023-01-20"),
        Transaction("987654321", "Transfer", -300.00, "2023-01-18")
    )

    fun getAccountByUsername(username: String): Account {
        // In a real app, this would query the database
        return accounts.firstOrNull { it.email == username } ?: throw Exception("Account not found")
    }

    fun getTransactions(accountNumber: String): List<Transaction> {
        return transactions.filter { it.accountNumber == accountNumber }
    }

    fun transferMoney(fromAccountNumber: String, toAccountNumber: String, amount: Double): Boolean {
        val fromAccount = accounts.find { it.accountNumber == fromAccountNumber } ?: return false
        val toAccount = accounts.find { it.accountNumber == toAccountNumber } ?: return false

        if (fromAccount.balance < amount) return false

        fromAccount.balance -= amount
        toAccount.balance += amount

        // Record transactions
        transactions.add(Transaction(fromAccountNumber, "Transfer to $toAccountNumber", -amount, getCurrentDate()))
        transactions.add(Transaction(toAccountNumber, "Transfer from $fromAccountNumber", amount, getCurrentDate()))

        return true
    }

    private fun getCurrentDate(): String {
        // Simple date format for demo purposes
        return java.text.SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd", java.util.Locale.getDefault()).format(java.util.Date())
    }
}
```

```kotlin
class BankService {
    private val users = mutableMapOf<String, User>()
    private val transactions = mutableMapOf<String, MutableList<Transaction>>()

    init {
        // Sample data
        val user1 = User(
            id = "1",
            name = "John Doe",
            email = "john@example.com",
            phone = "1234567890",
            accounts = listOf(
                Account(
                    accountNumber = "1234567890",
                    accountType = "Savings",
                    balance = 5000.0,
                    currency = "USD"
                ),
                Account(
                    accountNumber = "0987654321",
                    accountType = "Checking",
                    balance = 1000.0,
                    currency = "USD"
                )
            )
        )

        users[user1.email] = user1

        transactions[user1.id] = mutableListOf(
            Transaction(
                id = "1",
                date = "2023-01-15",
                amount = 1000.0,
                type = "DEPOSIT",
                description = "Salary deposit",
                balanceAfter = 5000.0
            ),
            Transaction(
                id = "2",
                date = "2023-01-20",
                amount = 50.0,
                type = "WITHDRAWAL",
                description = "ATM withdrawal",
                balanceAfter = 4950.0
            )
        )
    }

    fun login(email: String, password: String): User? {
        // In a real app, you would verify against a backend service
        return users[email]
    }

    fun getTransactions(userId: String): List<Transaction> {
        return transactions[userId] ?: emptyList()
    }

    fun transferMoney(
        fromAccount: String,
        toAccount: String,
        amount: Double,
        description: String
    ): Boolean {
        // In a real app, this would be a network call
        val user = users.values.find { it.accounts.any { acc -> acc.accountNumber == fromAccount } }
            ?: return false

        val fromAcc = user.accounts.find { it.accountNumber == fromAccount } ?: return false

        if (fromAcc.balance < amount) return false

        // Update balances
        val updatedAccounts = user.accounts.map {
            if (it.accountNumber == fromAccount) {
                it.copy(balance = it.balance - amount)
            } else if (it.accountNumber == toAccount) {
                it.copy(balance = it.balance + amount)
            } else {
                it
            }
        }

        val updatedUser = user.copy(accounts = updatedAccounts)
        users[user.email] = updatedUser

        // Add transaction records
        val transactionId = (transactions[user.id]?.size ?: 0).toString()
        val newTransaction = Transaction(
            id = transactionId,
            date = SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd", Locale.getDefault()).format(Date()),
            amount = amount,
            type = "TRANSFER",
            description = description,
            balanceAfter = fromAcc.balance - amount
        )

        transactions[user.id]?.add(newTransaction)

        return true
    }
}
```

```kotlin
        setupUI()
        setupListeners()

        // Display first account by default
        if (user.accounts.isNotEmpty()) {

            binding.tvAccountType.text = account.accountType
            binding.tvBalance.text = "$${account.balance}"

        binding.spinnerAccounts.adapter = adapter
    }

    private fun setupListeners() {
        binding.spinnerAccounts.onItemSelectedListener = object : AdapterView.OnItemSelectedListener {
            override fun onItemSelected(parent: AdapterView<*>?, view: View?, position: Int, id: Long) {
                val selectedAccount = user.accounts[position]
                binding.tvAccountNumber.text = selectedAccount.accountNumber
                binding.tvAccountType.text = selectedAccount.accountType
                binding.tvBalance.text = "$${selectedAccount.balance}"
            }

            override fun onNothingSelected(parent: AdapterView<*>?) {}
        }

        binding.btnViewTransactions.setOnClickListener {
            startActivity(Intent(this, TransactionActivity::class.java))
        }

        binding.btnTransfer.setOnClickListener {
            startActivity(Intent(this, TransferActivity::class.java))
        }

        binding.btnLogout.setOnClickListener {
            SharedPrefManager.getInstance(this).clear()
            startActivity(Intent(this, LoginActivity::class.java))

        }
    }
```

### adapters/TransactionAdapter.kt
```kotlin
class TransactionAdapter : ListAdapter<Transaction, TransactionAdapter.TransactionViewHolder>(DiffCallback()) {

    override fun onCreateViewHolder(parent: ViewGroup, viewType: Int): TransactionViewHolder {
        val binding = ItemTransactionBinding.inflate(
            LayoutInflater.from(parent.context),
            parent,
            false
        )
        return TransactionViewHolder(binding)
    }

    override fun onBindViewHolder(holder: TransactionViewHolder, position: Int) {
        val transaction = getItem(position)
        holder.bind(transaction)
    }

    class TransactionViewHolder(private val binding: ItemTransactionBinding) : RecyclerView.ViewHolder(binding.root) {
        fun bind(transaction: Transaction) {
            binding.tvDate.text = transaction.date
            binding.tvDescription.text = transaction.description
            binding.tvAmount.text = "$${transaction.amount}"

            // Set color based on transaction type
            when (transaction.type) {
                "DEPOSIT" -> binding.tvAmount.setTextColor(Color.GREEN)
                "WITHDRAWAL" -> binding.tvAmount.setTextColor(Color.RED)
                "TRANSFER" -> binding.tvAmount.setTextColor(Color.BLUE)
            }

            binding.tvBalanceAfter.text = "Balance: $${transaction.balanceAfter}"
        }
    }

    class DiffCallback : DiffUtil.ItemCallback<Transaction>() {
        override fun areItemsTheSame(oldItem: Transaction, newItem: Transaction): Boolean {
            return oldItem.id == newItem.id
        }

        override fun areContentsTheSame(oldItem: Transaction, newItem: Transaction): Boolean {
            return oldItem == newItem
        }
    }
}
```

### utils/SharedPrefManager.kt
```kotlin
class SharedPrefManager private constructor(private val context: Context) {
    private val sharedPreferences: SharedPreferences =
        context.getSharedPreferences(SHARED_PREF_NAME, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)

    companion object {
        private const val SHARED_PREF_NAME = "banking_app_pref"
        private const val KEY_USER_ID = "key_user_id"
        private const val KEY_USER_NAME = "key_user_name"
        private const val KEY_USER_EMAIL = "key_user_email"
        private const val KEY_USER_PHONE = "key_user_phone"

        @Volatile
        private var instance: SharedPrefManager? = null

        fun getInstance(context: Context): SharedPrefManager {
            return instance ?: synchronized(this) {
                instance ?: SharedPrefManager(context.applicationContext).also { instance = it }
            }
        }
    }

    fun saveUser(user: User) {
        val editor = sharedPreferences.edit()
        editor.putString(KEY_USER_ID, user.id)
        editor.putString(KEY_USER_NAME, user.name)
        editor.putString(KEY_USER_EMAIL, user.email)
        editor.putString(KEY_USER_PHONE, user.phone)
        editor.apply()
    }

    fun getUser(): User {
        return User(
            id = sharedPreferences.getString(KEY_USER_ID, "") ?: "",
            name = sharedPreferences.getString(KEY_USER_NAME, "") ?: "",
            email = sharedPreferences.getString(KEY_USER_EMAIL, "") ?: "",
            phone = sharedPreferences.getString(KEY_USER_PHONE, "") ?: "",
            accounts = emptyList() // In a real app, you would store accounts separately
        )
    }

    fun clear() {
        sharedPreferences.edit().clear().apply()
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package com.example.bankingapp

import android.content.Intent
import android.os.Bundle
import android.widget.Button

        val passwordEditText = findViewById<EditText>(R.id.passwordEditText)
        val loginButton = findViewById<Button>(R.id.loginButton)

        loginButton.setOnClickListener {
            val username = usernameEditText.text.toString()
            val password = passwordEditText.text.toString()

            if (validateCredentials(username, password)) {
                // Navigate to Dashboard
                val intent = Intent(this, DashboardActivity::class.java)
                intent.putExtra("USERNAME", username)
                startActivity(intent)
                finish()
            } else {
                Toast.makeText(this, "Invalid credentials", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            }
        }
    }

    private fun validateCredentials(username: String, password: String): Boolean {
        // In a real app, you would validate against a backend service
        return username == "user" && password == "password"
    }
```

### services/BankService.kt
```kotlin
class BankService {
    private val users = mutableMapOf<String, User>()
    private val transactions = mutableMapOf<String, MutableList<Transaction>>()

    init {
        // Sample data
        val user1 = User(
            id = "1",
            name = "John Doe",
            email = "john@example.com",
            accounts = listOf(
                Account(
                    accountNumber = "123456789",
                    accountType = "Savings",
                    balance = 5000.0,
                    currency = "USD"
                ),
                Account(
                    accountNumber = "987654321",
                    accountType = "Checking",
                    balance = 2500.0,
                    currency = "USD"
                )
            )
        )

        users[user1.id] = user1

        transactions[user1.id] = mutableListOf(
            Transaction(
                id = "1",
                date = "2023-05-01",
                amount = 1000.0,
                type = "DEPOSIT",
                description = "Salary deposit",
                balanceAfter = 5000.0
            ),
            Transaction(
                id = "2",
                date = "2023-05-05",
                amount = 50.0,
                type = "WITHDRAWAL",
                description = "Grocery shopping",
                balanceAfter = 4950.0
            )
        )
    }

    fun authenticate(email: String, password: String): User? {
        // In a real app, this would call an API
        return users.values.find { it.email == email }
    }

    fun getTransactions(userId: String): List<Transaction> {
        return transactions[userId] ?: emptyList()
    }

    fun transferMoney(fromAccount: String, toAccount: String, amount: Double): Boolean {
        // In a real app, this would be a network call
        val fromUser = users.values.find { user ->
            user.accounts.any { it.accountNumber == fromAccount }
        }

        val toUser = users.values.find { user ->
            user.accounts.any { it.accountNumber == toAccount }
        }

        if (fromUser != null && toUser != null) {
            val fromAccountObj = fromUser.accounts.find { it.accountNumber == fromAccount }
            val toAccountObj = toUser.accounts.find { it.accountNumber == toAccount }

            if (fromAccountObj != null && toAccountObj != null &&
                fromAccountObj.balance >= amount) {

                // Update balances
                val updatedFromAccount = fromAccountObj.copy(balance = fromAccountObj.balance - amount)
                val updatedToAccount = toAccountObj.copy(balance = toAccountObj.balance + amount)

                // Update user accounts
                val updatedFromUser = fromUser.copy(accounts = fromUser.accounts.map {
                    if (it.accountNumber == fromAccount) updatedFromAccount else it
                })

                val updatedToUser = toUser.copy(accounts = toUser.accounts.map {
                    if (it.accountNumber == toAccount) updatedToAccount else it
                })

                users[fromUser.id] = updatedFromUser
                users[toUser.id] = updatedToUser

                // Add transactions
                val transactionId = (transactions[fromUser.id]?.size?.plus(1) ?: 1).toString()
                val fromTransaction = Transaction(
                    id = transactionId,
                    date = SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd", Locale.getDefault()).format(Date()),
                    amount = amount,
                    type = "WITHDRAWAL",
                    description = "Transfer to $toAccount",
                    balanceAfter = updatedFromAccount.balance
                )

                val toTransaction = Transaction(
                    id = transactionId,
                    date = SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd", Locale.getDefault()).format(Date()),
                    amount = amount,
                    type = "DEPOSIT",
                    description = "Transfer from $fromAccount",
                    balanceAfter = updatedToAccount.balance
                )

                transactions[fromUser.id]?.add(fromTransaction)
                transactions[toUser.id]?.add(toTransaction)

                return true
            }
        }
        return false
    }
}
```

```kotlin
class TransactionActivity : AppCompatActivity() {
    private lateinit var binding: ActivityTransactionBinding
    private val bankService = BankService()
    private lateinit var transactionAdapter: TransactionAdapter

        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)

        setContentView(binding.root)

        val userId = intent.getStringExtra("USER_ID")
        val transactions = userId?.let { bankService.getTransactions(it) } ?: emptyList()

        transactionAdapter = TransactionAdapter(transactions)
        binding.transactionsRecyclerView.layoutManager = LinearLayoutManager(this)
        binding.transactionsRecyclerView.adapter = transactionAdapter
    }
```

```kotlin
class TransferActivity : AppCompatActivity() {
    private lateinit var binding: ActivityTransferBinding
    private val bankService = BankService()
    private var userId: String? = null

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        binding = ActivityTransferBinding.inflate(layoutInflater)
        setContentView(binding.root)

        userId = intent.getStringExtra("USER_ID")
        val user = userId?.let { bankService.authenticate("john@example.com", "password") }

        // Populate from account spinner
        val fromAccounts = user?.accounts?.map { it.accountNumber } ?: emptyList()
        val fromAdapter = ArrayAdapter(this, android.R.layout.simple_spinner_item, fromAccounts)
        binding.fromAccountSpinner.adapter = fromAdapter

        binding.transferButton.setOnClickListener {
            val fromAccount = binding.fromAccountSpinner.selectedItem.toString()
            val toAccount = binding.toAccountEditText.text.toString()
            val amount = binding.amountEditText.text.toString().toDoubleOrNull()

            if (toAccount.isNotEmpty() && amount != null && amount > 0) {
                val success = bankService.transferMoney(fromAccount, toAccount, amount)
                if (success) {
                    Toast.makeText(this, "Transfer successful", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                    finish()
                } else {
                    Toast.makeText(this, "Transfer failed", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                }
            } else {
                Toast.makeText(this, "Please fill all fields correctly", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package com.example.bankingapp

import android.content.Intent
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity
import android.os.Bundle
import android.widget.Button
import android.widget.EditText
import android.widget.Toast

class MainActivity : AppCompatActivity() {
    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        setContentView(R.layout.activity_main)

        val usernameEditText = findViewById<EditText>(R.id.usernameEditText)
        val passwordEditText = findViewById<EditText>(R.id.passwordEditText)
        val loginButton = findViewById<Button>(R.id.loginButton)

        loginButton.setOnClickListener {
            val username = usernameEditText.text.toString()
            val password = passwordEditText.text.toString()

            if (validateCredentials(username, password)) {
                // Navigate to Dashboard
                val intent = Intent(this, DashboardActivity::class.java)
                intent.putExtra("USERNAME", username)
                startActivity(intent)
                finish()
            } else {
                Toast.makeText(this, "Invalid credentials", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            }
        }
    }

    private fun validateCredentials(username: String, password: String): Boolean {
        // In a real app, you would validate against a backend service
        return username == "user" && password == "password"
    }
}
```

### services/BankService.kt
```kotlin
class BankService {
    private val users = mutableListOf<User>()
    private val transactions = mutableMapOf<String, MutableList<Transaction>>()

    init {
        // Sample data
        val sampleUser = User(
            id = "1",
            name = "John Doe",
            email = "john@example.com",
            password = "password123",
            accounts = listOf(
                Account(
                    accountNumber = "123456789",
                    accountType = "Savings",
                    balance = 5000.00,
                    currency = "USD"
                ),
                Account(
                    accountNumber = "987654321",
                    accountType = "Checking",
                    balance = 2500.00,
                    currency = "USD"
                )
            )
        )
        users.add(sampleUser)

        // Sample transactions
        transactions["123456789"] = mutableListOf(
            Transaction(
                id = "1",
                date = "2023-05-01",
                amount = 1000.00,
                type = "DEPOSIT",
                description = "Salary deposit",
                balanceAfter = 5000.00
            ),
            Transaction(
                id = "2",
                date = "2023-05-02",
                amount = 50.00,
                type = "WITHDRAWAL",
                description = "Grocery shopping",
                balanceAfter = 4950.00
            )
        )
    }

    fun login(email: String, password: String): User? {
        return users.find { it.email == email && it.password == password }
    }

    fun getTransactions(accountNumber: String): List<Transaction> {
        return transactions[accountNumber] ?: emptyList()
    }

    fun transferMoney(fromAccount: String, toAccount: String, amount: Double): Boolean {
        val fromUser = users.find { user ->
            user.accounts.any { it.accountNumber == fromAccount }
        } ?: return false

        val toUser = users.find { user ->
            user.accounts.any { it.accountNumber == toAccount }
        } ?: return false

        val fromAccountObj = fromUser.accounts.find { it.accountNumber == fromAccount }!!
        val toAccountObj = toUser.accounts.find { it.accountNumber == toAccount }!!

        if (fromAccountObj.balance < amount) return false

        // Update balances
        val updatedFromAccount = fromAccountObj.copy(balance = fromAccountObj.balance - amount)
        val updatedToAccount = toAccountObj.copy(balance = toAccountObj.balance + amount)

        // Update user accounts
        val updatedFromUser = fromUser.copy(accounts = fromUser.accounts.map {
            if (it.accountNumber == fromAccount) updatedFromAccount else it
        })

        val updatedToUser = toUser.copy(accounts = toUser.accounts.map {
            if (it.accountNumber == toAccount) updatedToAccount else it
        })

        // Update users list
        users.remove(fromUser)
        users.remove(toUser)
        users.add(updatedFromUser)
        users.add(updatedToUser)

        // Add transactions
        val fromTransaction = Transaction(
            id = UUID.randomUUID().toString(),
            date = SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd", Locale.getDefault()).format(Date()),
            amount = amount,
            type = "WITHDRAWAL",
            description = "Transfer to $toAccount",
            balanceAfter = updatedFromAccount.balance
        )

        val toTransaction = Transaction(
            id = UUID.randomUUID().toString(),
            date = SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd", Locale.getDefault()).format(Date()),
            amount = amount,
            type = "DEPOSIT",
            description = "Transfer from $fromAccount",
            balanceAfter = updatedToAccount.balance
        )

        transactions[fromAccount]?.add(fromTransaction)
        transactions[toAccount]?.add(toTransaction)

        return true
    }
}
```

```kotlin
class TransferActivity : AppCompatActivity() {
    private lateinit var binding: ActivityTransferBinding
    private val bankService = BankService()
    private lateinit var user: User

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        binding = ActivityTransferBinding.inflate(layoutInflater)
        setContentView(binding.root)

        val userId = intent.getStringExtra("USER_ID")
        user = bankService.users.find { it.id == userId }!!

        setupUI()
    }

    private fun setupUI() {
        // Set up from account spinner
        val fromAccounts = user.accounts.map { it.accountNumber }
        val fromAdapter = ArrayAdapter(this, android.R.layout.simple_spinner_item, fromAccounts)
        binding.fromAccountSpinner.adapter = fromAdapter

        // Set up to account edit text (could be improved with autocomplete)
        binding.transferButton.setOnClickListener {
            val fromAccount = binding.fromAccountSpinner.selectedItem.toString()
            val toAccount = binding.toAccountEditText.text.toString()
            val amount = binding.amountEditText.text.toString().toDoubleOrNull()

            if (amount == null || amount <= 0) {
                Toast.makeText(this, "Invalid amount", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                return@setOnClickListener
            }

            if (fromAccount == toAccount) {
                Toast.makeText(this, "Cannot transfer to same account", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                return@setOnClickListener
            }

            val success = bankService.transferMoney(fromAccount, toAccount, amount)
            if (success) {
                Toast.makeText(this, "Transfer successful", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                finish()
            } else {
                Toast.makeText(this, "Transfer failed", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```kotlin
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity
```

```kotlin
class TransferActivity : AppCompatActivity() {
    private lateinit var recipientEditText: EditText
    private lateinit var amountEditText: EditText
    private lateinit var transferButton: Button

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        setContentView(R.layout.activity_transfer)

        recipientEditText = findViewById(R.id.recipientEditText)
        amountEditText = findViewById(R.id.amountEditText)
        transferButton = findViewById(R.id.transferButton)

        transferButton.setOnClickListener {
            val recipient = recipientEditText.text.toString()
            val amount = amountEditText.text.toString().toDoubleOrNull()

            if (recipient.isNotEmpty() && amount != null && amount > 0) {
                // In a real app, you would process the transfer via API
                Toast.makeText(this, "Transfer of $$amount to $recipient successful", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                finish()
            } else {
                Toast.makeText(this, "Please enter valid recipient and amount", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```kotlin
        super.onViewCreated(view, savedInstanceState)

        setupRecyclerView()
        observeTransactions()
    }

    private fun setupRecyclerView() {
        adapter = TransactionAdapter()
        binding.transactionsRecyclerView.apply {
            layoutManager = LinearLayoutManager(requireContext())
            adapter = this@TransactionsFragment.adapter
            addItemDecoration(DividerItemDecoration(requireContext(), DividerItemDecoration.VERTICAL))
        }
    }

    private fun observeTransactions() {
        viewModel.transactions.observe(viewLifecycleOwner) { transactions ->
            adapter.submitList(transactions)
        }
    }

    override fun onDestroyView() {
        super.onDestroyView()
        _binding = null
    }
}
```

### TransactionAdapter.kt
```kotlin
class TransactionAdapter : ListAdapter<Transaction, TransactionAdapter.TransactionViewHolder>(DiffCallback()) {

    override fun onCreateViewHolder(parent: ViewGroup, viewType: Int): TransactionViewHolder {
        val binding = ItemTransactionBinding.inflate(
            LayoutInflater.from(parent.context),
            parent,
            false
        )
        return TransactionViewHolder(binding)
    }

    override fun onBindViewHolder(holder: TransactionViewHolder, position: Int) {
        val transaction = getItem(position)
        holder.bind(transaction)
    }

    class TransactionViewHolder(private val binding: ItemTransactionBinding) :
        RecyclerView.ViewHolder(binding.root) {

        fun bind(transaction: Transaction) {
            binding.apply {
                dateText.text = transaction.date
                descriptionText.text = transaction.description

                val amountText = if (transaction.amount >= 0) {
                    "+${transaction.amount}"
                } else {
                    transaction.amount.toString()
                }

                amountTextView.text = amountText
                balanceText.text = root.context.getString(
                    R.string.balance_after_format,
                    transaction.balanceAfter
                )

                // Set color based on transaction type
                val colorRes = when (transaction.type) {
                    TransactionType.DEPOSIT -> R.color.deposit_green
                    TransactionType.WITHDRAWAL -> R.color.withdrawal_red
                    else -> R.color.payment_blue
                }

                amountTextView.setTextColor(ContextCompat.getColor(root.context, colorRes))
            }
        }
    }

    private class DiffCallback : DiffUtil.ItemCallback<Transaction>() {
        override fun areItemsTheSame(oldItem: Transaction, newItem: Transaction): Boolean {
            return oldItem.id == newItem.id
        }

        override fun areContentsTheSame(oldItem: Transaction, newItem: Transaction): Boolean {
            return oldItem == newItem
        }
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package com.example.bankingapp.activities

import android.content.Intent
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity
import android.os.Bundle
import android.widget.Button
import android.widget.EditText
import android.widget.Toast

class LoginActivity : AppCompatActivity() {
    private lateinit var usernameEditText: EditText
    private lateinit var passwordEditText: EditText
    private lateinit var loginButton: Button

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        setContentView(R.layout.activity_login)

        usernameEditText = findViewById(R.id.usernameEditText)
        passwordEditText = findViewById(R.id.passwordEditText)
        loginButton = findViewById(R.id.loginButton)

        loginButton.setOnClickListener {
            val username = usernameEditText.text.toString()
            val password = passwordEditText.text.toString()

            if (BankService.authenticate(username, password)) {
                val intent = Intent(this, MainActivity::class.java)
                intent.putExtra("USERNAME", username)
                startActivity(intent)
                finish()
            } else {
                Toast.makeText(this, "Invalid credentials", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```kotlin
import android.widget.TextView
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.LinearLayoutManager
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView
import com.example.bankingapp.R
import com.example.bankingapp.adapters.TransactionAdapter
import com.example.bankingapp.models.Account
import com.example.bankingapp.models.Transaction
import com.example.bankingapp.services.BankService

class MainActivity : AppCompatActivity() {
    private lateinit var account: Account
    private lateinit var balanceTextView: TextView
    private lateinit var transactionsRecyclerView: RecyclerView
    private lateinit var transferButton: Button

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        setContentView(R.layout.activity_main)

        val username = intent.getStringExtra("USERNAME") ?: return
        account = BankService.getAccount(username)

        balanceTextView = findViewById(R.id.balanceTextView)
        transactionsRecyclerView = findViewById(R.id.transactionsRecyclerView)
        transferButton = findViewById(R.id.transferButton)

        balanceTextView.text = "Balance: $${account.balance}"

        setupTransactionsRecyclerView()

        transferButton.setOnClickListener {
            val intent = Intent(this, TransferActivity::class.java)
            intent.putExtra("ACCOUNT_NUMBER", account.accountNumber)
            startActivity(intent)
        }
    }

    private fun setupTransactionsRecyclerView() {
        val adapter = TransactionAdapter(account.transactions)
        transactionsRecyclerView.layoutManager = LinearLayoutManager(this)
        transactionsRecyclerView.adapter = adapter
    }

    override fun onResume() {
        super.onResume()
        // Refresh account data when returning to this activity
        account = BankService.getAccount(account.accountNumber)
        balanceTextView.text = "Balance: $${account.balance}"
        (transactionsRecyclerView.adapter as TransactionAdapter).updateTransactions(account.transactions)
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package com.example.bankingapp.services

import com.example.bankingapp.models.Account
import com.example.bankingapp.models.Transaction
import com.example.bankingapp.models.User

object BankService {
    private val users = mutableMapOf<String, User>()
    private val accounts = mutableMapOf<String, Account>()

    init {
        // Sample data
        val user1 = User("user1", "password1", "John Doe")
        val account1 = Account("ACC123456", 1000.0, mutableListOf(
            Transaction("Deposit", 500.0, "2023-01-01"),
            Transaction("Withdrawal", -200.0, "2023-01-05")
        ))

        val user2 = User("user2", "password2", "Jane Smith")
        val account2 = Account("ACC789012", 1500.0, mutableListOf(
            Transaction("Deposit", 1000.0, "2023-01-10"),
            Transaction("Withdrawal", -300.0, "2023-01-15")
        ))

        users["user1"] = user1
        accounts["ACC123456"] = account1

        users["user2"] = user2
        accounts["ACC789012"] = account2
    }

    fun authenticate(username: String, password: String): Boolean {
        return users[username]?.password == password
    }

    fun getAccount(username: String): Account {
        return accounts.values.first { it.accountNumber == username }
    }

    fun getAccount(accountNumber: String): Account {
        return accounts[accountNumber] ?: throw IllegalArgumentException("Account not found")
    }

    fun transfer(fromAccountNumber: String, toAccountNumber: String, amount: Double): Boolean {
        val fromAccount = accounts[fromAccountNumber] ?: return false
        val toAccount = accounts[toAccountNumber] ?: return false

        if (fromAccount.balance < amount) return false

        fromAccount.balance -= amount
        toAccount.balance += amount

        val transaction = Transaction("Transfer to $toAccountNumber", -amount, java.time.LocalDate.now().toString())
        fromAccount.transactions.add(transaction)

        val recipientTransaction = Transaction("Transfer from $fromAccountNumber", amount, java.time.LocalDate.now().toString())
        toAccount.transactions.add(recipientTransaction)

        return true
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package com.example.bankingapp.adapters

import android.view.LayoutInflater
import android.view.View
import android.view.ViewGroup
import android.widget.TextView
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView
import com.example.bankingapp.R
import com.example.bankingapp.models.Transaction

class TransactionAdapter(private var transactions: List<Transaction>) :
    RecyclerView.Adapter<TransactionAdapter.TransactionViewHolder>() {

    class TransactionViewHolder(itemView: View) : RecyclerView.ViewHolder(itemView) {
        val typeTextView: TextView = itemView.findViewById(R.id.typeTextView)
        val amountTextView: TextView = itemView.findViewById(R.id.amountTextView)
        val dateTextView: TextView = itemView.findViewById(R.id.dateTextView)
    }

    override fun onCreateViewHolder(parent: ViewGroup, viewType: Int): TransactionViewHolder {
        val view = LayoutInflater.from(parent.context)
            .inflate(R.layout.item_transaction, parent, false)
        return TransactionViewHolder(view)
    }

    override fun onBindViewHolder(holder: TransactionViewHolder, position: Int) {
        val transaction = transactions[position]
        holder.typeTextView.text = transaction.type
        holder.amountTextView.text = "$${transaction.amount}"
        holder.dateTextView.text = transaction.date
    }

    override fun getItemCount(): Int = transactions.size

    fun updateTransactions(newTransactions: List<Transaction>) {
        transactions = newTransactions
        notifyDataSetChanged()
    }
}
```

```kotlin
// LoginActivity.kt
class LoginActivity : AppCompatActivity() {

    private lateinit var binding: ActivityLoginBinding
    private lateinit var auth: FirebaseAuth

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        binding = ActivityLoginBinding.inflate(layoutInflater)
        setContentView(binding.root)

        auth = FirebaseAuth.getInstance()

        binding.loginButton.setOnClickListener {
            val email = binding.emailEditText.text.toString()
            val password = binding.passwordEditText.text.toString()

            if (email.isNotEmpty() && password.isNotEmpty()) {
                loginUser(email, password)
            } else {
                Toast.makeText(this, "Please fill all fields", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            }
        }

        binding.registerTextView.setOnClickListener {
            startActivity(Intent(this, RegisterActivity::class.java))
        }
    }

    private fun loginUser(email: String, password: String) {
        auth.signInWithEmailAndPassword(email, password)
            .addOnCompleteListener(this) { task ->
                if (task.isSuccessful) {
                    startActivity(Intent(this, MainActivity::class.java))
                    finish()
                } else {
                    Toast.makeText(this, "Authentication failed", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                }
            }
    }
}
```

```kotlin
class MainActivity : AppCompatActivity() {

        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        binding = ActivityMainBinding.inflate(layoutInflater)

        auth = FirebaseAuth.getInstance()
        db = FirebaseFirestore.getInstance()

            when (item.itemId) {
                R.id.nav_home -> {
                    // Show home fragment
                    true
                }
                R.id.nav_transactions -> {
                    // Show transactions fragment
                    true
                }
                R.id.nav_profile -> {
                    // Show profile fragment
                    true
                }
                else -> false
            }
        }
    }

    private fun loadAccountData() {
        val userId = auth.currentUser?.uid ?: return

        db.collection("accounts").document(userId)
            .get()
            .addOnSuccessListener { document ->
                if (document != null) {
                    val account = document.toObject(Account::class.java)
                    binding.balanceTextView.text = "$${account?.balance}"
                    binding.accountNumberTextView.text = "Account: ${account?.accountNumber}"
                }
            }
            .addOnFailureListener { exception ->
                Toast.makeText(this, "Error getting account data", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            }
```

```kotlin
// TransactionsFragment.kt
class TransactionsFragment : Fragment() {

    private lateinit var binding: FragmentTransactionsBinding
    private lateinit var auth: FirebaseAuth
    private lateinit var db: FirebaseFirestore
    private lateinit var adapter: TransactionAdapter

    override fun onCreateView(
        inflater: LayoutInflater, container: ViewGroup?,
        savedInstanceState: Bundle?
    ): View {
        binding = FragmentTransactionsBinding.inflate(inflater, container, false)
        return binding.root
    }

    override fun onViewCreated(view: View, savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onViewCreated(view, savedInstanceState)

        auth = FirebaseAuth.getInstance()
        db = FirebaseFirestore.getInstance()

        setupRecyclerView()
        loadTransactions()
    }

    private fun setupRecyclerView() {
        adapter = TransactionAdapter(emptyList())
        binding.transactionsRecyclerView.layoutManager = LinearLayoutManager(context)
        binding.transactionsRecyclerView.adapter = adapter
    }

    private fun loadTransactions() {
        val userId = auth.currentUser?.uid ?: return

        db.collection("transactions")
            .whereEqualTo("userId", userId)
            .orderBy("timestamp", Query.Direction.DESCENDING)
            .get()
            .addOnSuccessListener { documents ->
                val transactions = documents.map { it.toObject(Transaction::class.java) }
                adapter.updateTransactions(transactions)
            }
            .addOnFailureListener { exception ->
                Toast.makeText(context, "Error loading transactions", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            }
    }
}
```

### d. Money Transfer Activity

```kotlin
// TransferActivity.kt
class TransferActivity : AppCompatActivity() {

    private lateinit var binding: ActivityTransferBinding
    private lateinit var auth: FirebaseAuth
    private lateinit var db: FirebaseFirestore

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        binding = ActivityTransferBinding.inflate(layoutInflater)
        setContentView(binding.root)

        auth = FirebaseAuth.getInstance()
        db = FirebaseFirestore.getInstance()

        binding.transferButton.setOnClickListener {
            val recipientAccount = binding.recipientAccountEditText.text.toString()
            val amount = binding.amountEditText.text.toString().toDoubleOrNull()

            if (recipientAccount.isNotEmpty() && amount != null && amount > 0) {
                processTransfer(recipientAccount, amount)
            } else {
                Toast.makeText(this, "Please enter valid details", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            }
        }
    }

    private fun processTransfer(recipientAccount: String, amount: Double) {
        val userId = auth.currentUser?.uid ?: return

        db.runTransaction { transaction ->
            // Get sender's account
            val senderRef = db.collection("accounts").document(userId)
            val senderDoc = transaction.get(senderRef)
            val senderBalance = senderDoc.getDouble("balance") ?: 0.0

            if (senderBalance < amount) {
                throw Exception("Insufficient funds")
            }

            // Get recipient's account
            val recipientQuery = db.collection("accounts")
                .whereEqualTo("accountNumber", recipientAccount)
                .limit(1)

            val recipientSnapshot = transaction.get(recipientQuery).get()
            if (recipientSnapshot.isEmpty) {
                throw Exception("Recipient account not found")
            }

            val recipientDoc = recipientSnapshot.documents[0]
            val recipientBalance = recipientDoc.getDouble("balance") ?: 0.0

            // Update balances
            transaction.update(senderRef, "balance", senderBalance - amount)
            transaction.update(recipientDoc.reference, "balance", recipientBalance + amount)

            // Create transaction records
            val transactionId = db.collection("transactions").document().id
            val timestamp = FieldValue.serverTimestamp()

            val senderTransaction = hashMapOf(
                "userId" to userId,
                "type" to "DEBIT",
                "amount" to amount,
                "recipient" to recipientAccount,
                "timestamp" to timestamp
            )

            val recipientTransaction = hashMapOf(
                "userId" to recipientDoc.id,
                "type" to "CREDIT",
                "amount" to amount,
                "sender" to senderDoc.getString("accountNumber"),
                "timestamp" to timestamp
            )

            transaction.set(db.collection("transactions").document(transactionId), senderTransaction)
            transaction.set(db.collection("transactions").document(), recipientTransaction)

            null
        }.addOnSuccessListener {
            Toast.makeText(this, "Transfer successful", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            finish()
        }.addOnFailureListener { e ->
            Toast.makeText(this, "Transfer failed: ${e.message}", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
        }
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package com.example.bankingapp.activities

class MainActivity : AppCompatActivity() {

    private lateinit var authService: AuthService

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        setContentView(R.layout.activity_main)

        authService = AuthService()

        val usernameEditText = findViewById<EditText>(R.id.usernameEditText)
        val passwordEditText = findViewById<EditText>(R.id.passwordEditText)
        val loginButton = findViewById<Button>(R.id.loginButton)

        loginButton.setOnClickListener {
            val username = usernameEditText.text.toString()
            val password = passwordEditText.text.toString()

            if (username.isEmpty() || password.isEmpty()) {
                Toast.makeText(this, "Please enter both username and password", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                return@setOnClickListener
            }

            val user = authService.authenticate(username, password)
            if (user != null) {
                // Login successful
                val intent = Intent(this, DashboardActivity::class.java)
                intent.putExtra("USER", user)
                startActivity(intent)
                finish()
            } else {
                // Login failed
                Toast.makeText(this, "Invalid credentials", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```kotlin
class TransactionsFragment : Fragment() {

    private val viewModel: TransactionsViewModel by viewModels()
    private lateinit var adapter: TransactionAdapter

    override fun onCreateView(
        inflater: LayoutInflater,
        container: ViewGroup?,
        savedInstanceState: Bundle?
    ): View {

        return binding.root
    }

        adapter = TransactionAdapter()
        binding.transactionsRecyclerView.layoutManager = LinearLayoutManager(requireContext())
        binding.transactionsRecyclerView.adapter = adapter

        viewModel.transactions.observe(viewLifecycleOwner) { transactions ->
            adapter.submitList(transactions)
        }
    }
}

class TransactionAdapter : ListAdapter<Transaction, TransactionAdapter.TransactionViewHolder>(DiffCallback()) {

    override fun onCreateViewHolder(parent: ViewGroup, viewType: Int): TransactionViewHolder {
        val binding = ItemTransactionBinding.inflate(
            LayoutInflater.from(parent.context),
            parent,
            false
        )
        return TransactionViewHolder(binding)
    }

    override fun onBindViewHolder(holder: TransactionViewHolder, position: Int) {
        holder.bind(getItem(position))
    }

    class TransactionViewHolder(private val binding: ItemTransactionBinding) :
        RecyclerView.ViewHolder(binding.root) {

        fun bind(transaction: Transaction) {
            binding.transactionDate.text = transaction.date
            binding.transactionDescription.text = transaction.description
            binding.transactionAmount.text = CurrencyFormatter.format(transaction.amount, "USD")
            binding.transactionAmount.setTextColor(
                if (transaction.amount >= 0) {
                    ContextCompat.getColor(binding.root.context, R.color.green)
                } else {
                    ContextCompat.getColor(binding.root.context, R.color.red)
                }
            )
        }
    }

    private class DiffCallback : DiffUtil.ItemCallback<Transaction>() {
        override fun areItemsTheSame(oldItem: Transaction, newItem: Transaction): Boolean {
            return oldItem.id == newItem.id
        }

        override fun areContentsTheSame(oldItem: Transaction, newItem: Transaction): Boolean {
            return oldItem == newItem
        }
    }
}
```

### services/BankService.kt
```kotlin
class BankService {
    private val users = mutableListOf<User>()
    private val transactions = mutableMapOf<String, MutableList<Transaction>>()

    init {
        // Sample data
        val user1 = User(
            id = "1",
            name = "John Doe",
            email = "john@example.com",
            password = "password123",
            accounts = listOf(
                Account(
                    accountNumber = "123456789",
                    accountType = "Savings",
                    balance = 5000.0,
                    currency = "USD"
                ),
                Account(
                    accountNumber = "987654321",
                    accountType = "Checking",
                    balance = 2500.0,
                    currency = "USD"
                )
            )
        )

        users.add(user1)

        // Sample transactions
        transactions["123456789"] = mutableListOf(
            Transaction(
                id = "1",
                date = "2023-05-01",
                amount = 100.0,
                description = "Grocery Store",
                type = "debit",
                balanceAfter = 4900.0
            ),
            Transaction(
                id = "2",
                date = "2023-05-02",
                amount = 500.0,
                description = "Salary Deposit",
                type = "credit",
                balanceAfter = 5400.0
            )
        )
    }

    fun authenticate(email: String, password: String): User? {
        return users.find { it.email == email && it.password == password }
    }

    fun getTransactions(accountNumber: String): List<Transaction> {
        return transactions[accountNumber] ?: emptyList()
    }

    fun transferMoney(
        fromAccount: String,
        toAccount: String,
        amount: Double,
        description: String
    ): Boolean {
        val fromUser = users.find { account ->
            account.accounts.any { it.accountNumber == fromAccount }
        } ?: return false

        val toUser = users.find { account ->
            account.accounts.any { it.accountNumber == toAccount }
        } ?: return false

        val fromAccountObj = fromUser.accounts.find { it.accountNumber == fromAccount }!!
        val toAccountObj = toUser.accounts.find { it.accountNumber == toAccount }!!

        if (fromAccountObj.balance < amount) return false

        // Update balances
        fromAccountObj.balance -= amount
        toAccountObj.balance += amount

        // Add transactions
        val transactionId = (transactions[fromAccount]?.size ?: 0).toString()
        transactions.getOrPut(fromAccount) { mutableListOf() }.add(
            Transaction(
                id = transactionId,
                date = SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd", Locale.getDefault()).format(Date()),
                amount = amount,
                description = "Transfer to $toAccount",
                type = "debit",
                balanceAfter = fromAccountObj.balance
            )
        )

        transactions.getOrPut(toAccount) { mutableListOf() }.add(
            Transaction(
                id = transactionId,
                date = SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd", Locale.getDefault()).format(Date()),
                amount = amount,
                description = "Transfer from $fromAccount",
                type = "credit",
                balanceAfter = toAccountObj.balance
            )
        )

        return true
    }
}
```

```kotlin
class MainActivity : AppCompatActivity() {
    private lateinit var binding: ActivityMainBinding
    private val bankService = BankService()
    private var currentUser: User? = null

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        binding = ActivityMainBinding.inflate(layoutInflater)
        setContentView(binding.root)

        val userId = intent.getStringExtra("USER_ID")
        currentUser = bankService.users.find { it.id == userId }

        setupUI()
    }

    private fun setupUI() {
        currentUser?.let { user ->
            binding.welcomeText.text = "Welcome, ${user.name}"

            // Display first account by default
            if (user.accounts.isNotEmpty()) {
                displayAccount(user.accounts[0])
            }

            // Setup account spinner
            val accountNumbers = user.accounts.map { it.accountNumber }
            val adapter = ArrayAdapter(this, android.R.layout.simple_spinner_item, accountNumbers)
            adapter.setDropDownViewResource(android.R.layout.simple_spinner_dropdown_item)
            binding.accountSpinner.adapter = adapter

            binding.accountSpinner.onItemSelectedListener = object : AdapterView.OnItemSelectedListener {
                override fun onItemSelected(parent: AdapterView<*>?, view: View?, position: Int, id: Long) {
                    displayAccount(user.accounts[position])
                }

                override fun onNothingSelected(parent: AdapterView<*>?) {}
            }

            binding.viewTransactionsButton.setOnClickListener {
                val selectedAccount = user.accounts[binding.accountSpinner.selectedItemPosition]
                val intent = Intent(this, TransactionActivity::class.java).apply {
                    putExtra("ACCOUNT_NUMBER", selectedAccount.accountNumber)
                }
                startActivity(intent)
            }

            binding.transferButton.setOnClickListener {
                val intent = Intent(this, TransferActivity::class.java).apply {
                    putExtra("USER_ID", currentUser?.id)
                }
                startActivity(intent)
            }
        }
    }

    private fun displayAccount(account: Account) {
        binding.accountTypeText.text = account.accountType
        binding.accountNumberText.text = account.accountNumber
        binding.balanceText.text = String.format("$%.2f", account.balance)
    }
}
```

```kotlin
class TransactionAdapter(private val transactions: List<Transaction>) :
    RecyclerView.Adapter<TransactionAdapter.TransactionViewHolder>() {

    class TransactionViewHolder(val binding: ItemTransactionBinding) : RecyclerView.ViewHolder(binding.root)

    override fun onCreateViewHolder(parent: ViewGroup, viewType: Int): TransactionViewHolder {
        val binding = ItemTransactionBinding.inflate(
            LayoutInflater.from(parent.context),
            parent,
            false
        )
        return TransactionViewHolder(binding)
    }

    override fun onBindViewHolder(holder: TransactionViewHolder, position: Int) {
        val transaction = transactions[position]
        holder.binding.dateText.text = transaction.date
        holder.binding.descriptionText.text = transaction.description
        holder.binding.amountText.text = String.format("$%.2f", transaction.amount)

        // Set color based on transaction type
        val color = if (transaction.type == "credit") {
            ContextCompat.getColor(holder.itemView.context, android.R.color.holo_green_dark)
        } else {
            ContextCompat.getColor(holder.itemView.context, android.R.color.holo_red_dark)
        }
        holder.binding.amountText.setTextColor(color)
    }

    override fun getItemCount() = transactions.size
}
```

```kotlin
package com.example.bankingapp.activities

import android.content.Intent
import android.os.Bundle
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity

import com.example.bankingapp.R

import com.example.bankingapp.models.Transaction

import com.example.bankingapp.services.BankingService
import com.example.bankingapp.utils.AuthManager
import kotlinx.android.synthetic.main.activity_main.*

class MainActivity : AppCompatActivity() {

    private lateinit var bankingService: BankingService
    private lateinit var authManager: AuthManager
    private lateinit var transactionAdapter: TransactionAdapter

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        setContentView(R.layout.activity_main)

        // Initialize services
        bankingService = BankingService()
        authManager = AuthManager(this)

        // Check if user is logged in
        if (!authManager.isLoggedIn()) {
            startActivity(Intent(this, LoginActivity::class.java))
            finish()
            return
        }

        setupUI()
        loadUserData()
        loadTransactions()
    }

    private fun setupUI() {
        // Set up RecyclerView for transactions
        transactionAdapter = TransactionAdapter(emptyList())
        rvTransactions.layoutManager = LinearLayoutManager(this)
        rvTransactions.adapter = transactionAdapter

        // Set click listeners
        btnTransfer.setOnClickListener {
            startActivity(Intent(this, TransferActivity::class.java))
        }

        btnLogout.setOnClickListener {
            authManager.logout()
            startActivity(Intent(this, LoginActivity::class.java))
            finish()
        }
    }

    private fun loadUserData() {
        val user = authManager.getCurrentUser()
        user?.let {
            tvAccountName.text = it.name
            tvAccountNumber.text = "Account: ${it.accountNumber}"
            tvBalance.text = "Balance: $${String.format("%.2f", it.balance)}"
        }
    }

    private fun loadTransactions() {
        val user = authManager.getCurrentUser()
        user?.let {
            val transactions = bankingService.getTransactions(it.accountNumber)
            transactionAdapter.updateTransactions(transactions)
        }
    }
}
```

```kotlin
                return@setOnClickListener
            }

            val sender = authManager.getCurrentUser()
            sender?.let {
                if (bankingService.transferMoney(it.accountNumber, recipientAccount, amount)) {
                    Toast.makeText(this, "Transfer successful", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                    finish()
                } else {
                    Toast.makeText(this, "Transfer failed", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package com.example.bankingapp.utils

import android.content.Context
import android.content.SharedPreferences
import com.example.bankingapp.models.User

class AuthManager(context: Context) {

    private val sharedPreferences: SharedPreferences =
        context.getSharedPreferences("BankingAppPrefs", Context.MODE_PRIVATE)

    fun login(accountNumber: String, pin: String): Boolean {
        // In a real app, you would validate against a backend service
        // This is a simplified example
        if (accountNumber == "123456789" && pin == "1234") {
            val user = User(
                name = "John Doe",
                accountNumber = accountNumber,
                balance = 1000.00,
                pin = pin
            )
            saveUser(user)
            return true
        }
        return false
    }

    fun logout() {
        sharedPreferences.edit().clear().apply()
    }

    fun isLoggedIn(): Boolean {
        return sharedPreferences.contains("accountNumber")
    }

    fun getCurrentUser(): User? {
        if (!isLoggedIn()) return null

        return User(
            name = sharedPreferences.getString("name", "") ?: "",
            accountNumber = sharedPreferences.getString("accountNumber", "") ?: "",
            balance = sharedPreferences.getFloat("balance", 0f).toDouble(),
            pin = sharedPreferences.getString("pin", "") ?: ""
        )
    }

    private fun saveUser(user: User) {
        with(sharedPreferences.edit()) {
            putString("name", user.name)
            putString("accountNumber", user.accountNumber)
            putFloat("balance", user.balance.toFloat())
            putString("pin", user.pin)
            apply()
        }
    }
}
```

```kotlin
import android.content.Intent
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity
import android.os.Bundle
import android.widget.Button
import android.widget.EditText
import android.widget.Toast

class LoginActivity : AppCompatActivity() {
    private lateinit var etUsername: EditText
    private lateinit var etPassword: EditText
    private lateinit var btnLogin: Button

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        setContentView(R.layout.activity_login)

        etUsername = findViewById(R.id.etUsername)
        etPassword = findViewById(R.id.etPassword)
        btnLogin = findViewById(R.id.btnLogin)

        btnLogin.setOnClickListener {
            val username = etUsername.text.toString()
            val password = etPassword.text.toString()

            if (validateCredentials(username, password)) {
                // Navigate to main activity
                val intent = Intent(this, MainActivity::class.java)
                intent.putExtra("USERNAME", username)
                startActivity(intent)
                finish()
            } else {
                Toast.makeText(this, "Invalid credentials", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            }
        }
    }

    private fun validateCredentials(username: String, password: String): Boolean {
        // In a real app, you would validate against a backend service
        return username == "user" && password == "password"
    }
}
```

```kotlin
import kotlinx.android.synthetic.main.activity_transfer.*

class TransferActivity : AppCompatActivity() {

    private lateinit var bankingService: BankingService

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        setContentView(R.layout.activity_transfer)

        bankingService = BankingService(this)

        btnSendMoney.setOnClickListener {
            val recipientAccount = etRecipientAccount.text.toString()
            val amount = etAmount.text.toString().toDoubleOrNull()

            if (recipientAccount.isEmpty() || amount == null || amount <= 0) {
                Toast.makeText(this, "Please enter valid details", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                return@setOnClickListener
            }

            val success = bankingService.transferMoney(
                bankingService.getCurrentUser().accountNumber,
                recipientAccount,
                amount
            )

            if (success) {
                Toast.makeText(this, "Transfer successful", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                finish()
            } else {
                Toast.makeText(this, "Transfer failed", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package com.example.bankingapp.services

import android.content.Context
import com.example.bankingapp.models.Transaction
import com.example.bankingapp.models.User
import com.example.bankingapp.utils.DatabaseHelper

class BankingService(private val context: Context) {

    private val dbHelper = DatabaseHelper(context)

    fun authenticate(username: String, password: String): Boolean {
        // In a real app, this would be more secure (hashing, etc.)
        return dbHelper.authenticateUser(username, password)
    }

    fun getCurrentUser(): User {
        // In a real app, this would get the currently logged-in user
        return dbHelper.getUserById(1) // Assuming ID 1 for demo
    }

    fun getRecentTransactions(accountNumber: String, limit: Int): List<Transaction> {
        return dbHelper.getTransactions(accountNumber, limit)
    }

    fun transferMoney(fromAccount: String, toAccount: String, amount: Double): Boolean {
        // Check if accounts exist and have sufficient funds
        val fromUser = dbHelper.getUserByAccountNumber(fromAccount)
        val toUser = dbHelper.getUserByAccountNumber(toAccount)

        if (fromUser == null || toUser == null || fromUser.balance < amount) {
            return false
        }

        // Perform the transfer
        dbHelper.updateBalance(fromAccount, fromUser.balance - amount)
        dbHelper.updateBalance(toAccount, toUser.balance + amount)

        // Record the transaction
        val transaction = Transaction(
            fromAccount = fromAccount,
            toAccount = toAccount,
            amount = amount,
            timestamp = System.currentTimeMillis(),
            description = "Transfer"
        )

        dbHelper.addTransaction(transaction)

        return true
    }
}
```
