```kotlin
package com.example.bankingapp.utils

import android.content.ContentValues
import android.content.Context
import android.database.sqlite.SQLiteDatabase
import android.database.sqlite.SQLiteOpenHelper
import com.example.bankingapp.models.Transaction
import com.example.bankingapp.models.User

class DatabaseHelper(context: Context) : SQLiteOpenHelper(context, DATABASE_NAME, null, DATABASE_VERSION) {

    companion object {
        private const val DATABASE_NAME = "BankingApp.db"
        private const val DATABASE_VERSION = 1

        // User table
        private const val TABLE_USERS = "users"
        private const val COLUMN_USER_ID = "id"
        private const val COLUMN_USER_NAME = "name"
        private const val COLUMN_USER_ACCOUNT_NUMBER = "account_number"
        private const val COLUMN_USER_BALANCE = "balance"
        private const val COLUMN_USER_USERNAME = "username"
        private const val COLUMN_USER_PASSWORD = "password"

        // Transactions table
        private const val TABLE_TRANSACTIONS = "transactions"
        private const val COLUMN_TRANSACTION_ID = "id"
        private const val COLUMN_TRANSACTION_FROM = "from_account"
        private const val COLUMN_TRANSACTION_TO = "to_account"
        private const val COLUMN_TRANSACTION_AMOUNT = "amount"
        private const val COLUMN_TRANSACTION_TIMESTAMP = "timestamp"
        private const val COLUMN_TRANSACTION_DESCRIPTION = "description"
    }

    override fun onCreate(db: SQLiteDatabase) {
        // Create users table
        val createUsersTable = """
            CREATE TABLE $TABLE_USERS (
                $COLUMN_USER_ID INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                $COLUMN_USER_NAME TEXT NOT NULL,
                $COLUMN_USER_ACCOUNT_NUMBER TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
                $COLUMN_USER_BALANCE REAL NOT NULL,
                $COLUMN_USER_USERNAME TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
                $COLUMN_USER_PASSWORD TEXT NOT NULL
            )
        """.trimIndent()

        // Create transactions table
        val createTransactionsTable = """
            CREATE TABLE $TABLE_TRANSACTIONS (
                $COLUMN_TRANSACTION_ID INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                $COLUMN_TRANSACTION_FROM TEXT NOT NULL,
                $COLUMN_TRANSACTION_TO TEXT NOT NULL,
                $COLUMN_TRANSACTION_AMOUNT REAL NOT NULL,
                $COLUMN_TRANSACTION_TIMESTAMP INTEGER NOT NULL,
                $COLUMN_TRANSACTION_DESCRIPTION TEXT
            )
        """.trimIndent()

        db.execSQL(createUsersTable)
        db.execSQL(createTransactionsTable)

        // Insert sample data
        insertSampleData(db)
    }

    private fun insertSampleData(db: SQLiteDatabase) {
        // Insert sample user
        val userValues = ContentValues().apply {
            put(COLUMN_USER_NAME, "John Doe")
            put(COLUMN_USER_ACCOUNT_NUMBER, "1234567890")
            put(COLUMN_USER_BALANCE, 1000.0)
            put(COLUMN_USER_USERNAME, "john")
            put(COLUMN_USER_PASSWORD, "password123") // In real app, this would be hashed
        }
        db.insert(TABLE_USERS, null, userValues)

        // Insert another sample user
        val anotherUserValues = ContentValues().apply {
            put(COLUMN_USER_NAME, "Jane Smith")
            put(COLUMN_USER_ACCOUNT_NUMBER, "0987654321")
            put(COLUMN_USER_BALANCE, 500.0)
            put(COLUMN_USER_USERNAME, "jane")
            put(COLUMN_USER_PASSWORD, "password456")
        }
        db.insert(TABLE_USERS, null, anotherUserValues)

        // Insert sample transactions
        val transactionValues = ContentValues().apply {
            put(COLUMN_TRANSACTION_FROM, "1234567890")
            put(COLUMN_TRANSACTION_TO, "0987654321")
            put(COLUMN_TRANSACTION_AMOUNT, 100.0)
            put(COLUMN_TRANSACTION_TIMESTAMP, System.currentTimeMillis())
            put(COLUMN_TRANSACTION_DESCRIPTION, "Sample transfer")
        }
        db.insert(TABLE_TRANSACTIONS, null, transactionValues)
    }

    override fun onUpgrade(db: SQLiteDatabase, oldVersion: Int, newVersion: Int) {
        db.execSQL("DROP TABLE IF EXISTS $TABLE_USERS")
        db.execSQL("DROP TABLE IF EXISTS $TABLE_TRANSACTIONS")
        onCreate(db)
    }

    // User operations
    fun authenticateUser(username: String, password: String): Boolean {
        val db = readableDatabase
        val cursor = db.query(
            TABLE_USERS,
            arrayOf(COLUMN_USER_ID),
            "$COLUMN_USER_USERNAME = ? AND $COLUMN_USER_PASSWORD = ?",
            arrayOf(username, password),
            null, null, null
        )

        val exists = cursor.count > 0
        cursor.close()
        return exists
    }

    fun getUserById(id: Int): User {
        val db = readableDatabase
        val cursor = db.query(
            TABLE_USERS,
            arrayOf(COLUMN_USER_NAME, COLUMN_USER_ACCOUNT_NUMBER, COLUMN_USER_BALANCE),
            "$COLUMN_USER_ID = ?",
            arrayOf(id.toString()),
            null, null, null
        )

        cursor.moveToFirst()
        val user = User(
            name = cursor.getString(0),
            accountNumber = cursor.getString(1),
            balance = cursor.getDouble(2)
        )

        cursor.close()
        return user
    }

    fun getUserByAccountNumber(accountNumber: String): User? {
        val db = readableDatabase
        val cursor = db.query(
            TABLE_USERS,
            arrayOf(COLUMN_USER_NAME, COLUMN_USER_ACCOUNT_NUMBER, COLUMN_USER_BALANCE),
            "$COLUMN_USER_ACCOUNT_NUMBER = ?",
            arrayOf(accountNumber),
            null, null, null
        )

        return if (cursor.moveToFirst()) {
            val user = User(
                name = cursor.getString(0),
                accountNumber = cursor.getString(1),
                balance = cursor.getDouble(2)
            )
            cursor.close()
            user
        } else {
            cursor.close()
            null
        }
    }

    fun updateBalance(accountNumber: String, newBalance: Double): Boolean {
        val db = writableDatabase
        val values = ContentValues().apply {
            put(COLUMN_USER_BALANCE, newBalance)
        }

        val rowsAffected = db.update(
            TABLE_USERS,
            values,
            "$COLUMN_USER_ACCOUNT_NUMBER = ?",
            arrayOf(accountNumber)
        )

        return rowsAffected > 0
    }

    // Transaction operations
    fun getTransactions(accountNumber: String, limit: Int): List<Transaction> {
        val db = readableDatabase
        val transactions = mutableListOf<Transaction>()

        val cursor = db.query(
            TABLE_TRANSACTIONS,
            arrayOf(
                COLUMN_TRANSACTION_FROM,
                COLUMN_TRANSACTION_TO,
                COLUMN_TRANSACTION_AMOUNT,
                COLUMN_TRANSACTION_TIMESTAMP,
                COLUMN_TRANSACTION_DESCRIPTION
            ),
            "$COLUMN_TRANSACTION_FROM = ? OR $COLUMN_TRANSACTION_TO = ?",
            arrayOf(accountNumber, accountNumber),
            null, null,
            "$COLUMN_TRANSACTION_TIMESTAMP DESC",
            limit.toString()
        )

        while (cursor.moveToNext()) {
            transactions.add(
                Transaction(
                    fromAccount = cursor.getString(0),
                    toAccount = cursor.getString(1),
                    amount = cursor.getDouble(2),
                    timestamp = cursor.getLong(3),
                    description = cursor.getString(4)
                )
            )
        }

        cursor.close()
        return transactions
    }

    fun addTransaction(transaction: Transaction): Long {
        val db = writableDatabase
        val values = ContentValues().apply {
            put(COLUMN_TRANSACTION_FROM, transaction.fromAccount)
            put(COLUMN_TRANSACTION_TO, transaction.toAccount)
            put(COLUMN_TRANSACTION_AMOUNT, transaction.amount)
            put(COLUMN_TRANSACTION_TIMESTAMP, transaction.timestamp)
            put(COLUMN_TRANSACTION_DESCRIPTION, transaction.description)
        }

        return db.insert(TABLE_TRANSACTIONS, null, values)
    }
}
```

## 10. Transaction Adapter (TransactionAdapter.kt)

```kotlin
import android.view.LayoutInflater
import android.view.ViewGroup
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView
import com.example.bankingapp.databinding.ItemTransactionBinding

class TransactionAdapter(private val transactions: List<Transaction>) :
    RecyclerView.Adapter<TransactionAdapter.TransactionViewHolder>() {

    inner class TransactionViewHolder(private val binding: ItemTransactionBinding) :
        RecyclerView.ViewHolder(binding.root) {
        fun bind(transaction: Transaction) {
            binding.tvMerchant.text = transaction.merchant
            binding.tvDate.text = transaction.date
            binding.tvAmount.text = "$${"%.2f".format(transaction.amount)}"

            // Set color based on transaction type
            if (transaction.amount < 0) {
                binding.tvAmount.setTextColor(binding.root.context.getColor(android.R.color.holo_red_light))
            } else {
                binding.tvAmount.setTextColor(binding.root.context.getColor(android.R.color.holo_green_light))
            }
        }
    }

    override fun onCreateViewHolder(parent: ViewGroup, viewType: Int): TransactionViewHolder {
        val binding = ItemTransactionBinding.inflate(
            LayoutInflater.from(parent.context),
            parent,
            false
        )
        return TransactionViewHolder(binding)
    }

    override fun onBindViewHolder(holder: TransactionViewHolder, position: Int) {
        holder.bind(transactions[position])
    }

    override fun getItemCount(): Int = transactions.size
}
```

```kotlin
import android.content.Intent
import android.os.Bundle
import android.widget.Toast
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity
import com.example.bankingapp.databinding.ActivityLoginBinding

class LoginActivity : AppCompatActivity() {
    private lateinit var binding: ActivityLoginBinding

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        binding = ActivityLoginBinding.inflate(layoutInflater)
        setContentView(binding.root)

        binding.btnLogin.setOnClickListener {
            val username = binding.etUsername.text.toString()
            val password = binding.etPassword.text.toString()

            // Simple validation - in a real app, you would authenticate with a backend
            if (username.isNotEmpty() && password.isNotEmpty()) {
                // Successful login - navigate to main activity
                val intent = Intent(this, MainActivity::class.java)
                startActivity(intent)
                finish()
            } else {
                Toast.makeText(this, "Please enter username and password", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            }
        }

        binding.tvForgotPassword.setOnClickListener {
            // Handle forgot password
            Toast.makeText(this, "Forgot password clicked", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
        }

        binding.tvSignUp.setOnClickListener {
            // Handle sign up
            Toast.makeText(this, "Sign up clicked", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
        }
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package com.example.bankingapp

import android.os.Bundle
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity
import androidx.navigation.findNavController
import androidx.navigation.ui.AppBarConfiguration
import androidx.navigation.ui.setupActionBarWithNavController
import androidx.navigation.ui.setupWithNavController
import com.example.bankingapp.databinding.ActivityMainBinding
import com.google.android.material.bottomnavigation.BottomNavigationView

class MainActivity : AppCompatActivity() {

    private lateinit var binding: ActivityMainBinding

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)

        binding = ActivityMainBinding.inflate(layoutInflater)
        setContentView(binding.root)

        val navView: BottomNavigationView = binding.navView

        val navController = findNavController(R.id.nav_host_fragment_activity_main)
        // Passing each menu ID as a set of Ids because each
        // menu should be considered as top level destinations.
        val appBarConfiguration = AppBarConfiguration(
            setOf(
                R.id.navigation_home, R.id.navigation_transactions, R.id.navigation_accounts
            )
        )
        setupActionBarWithNavController(navController, appBarConfiguration)
        navView.setupWithNavController(navController)
    }
}
```

```kotlin
class LoginActivity : AppCompatActivity() {
    private lateinit var binding: ActivityLoginBinding
    private lateinit var authViewModel: AuthViewModel

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        binding = ActivityLoginBinding.inflate(layoutInflater)
        setContentView(binding.root)

        // Initialize ViewModel
        authViewModel = ViewModelProvider(this).get(AuthViewModel::class.java)

        // Setup login button
        binding.btnLogin.setOnClickListener {
            val username = binding.etUsername.text.toString()
            val password = binding.etPassword.text.toString()

            if (validateInputs(username, password)) {
                authViewModel.login(username, password)
            }
        }

        // Observe login result
        authViewModel.loginResult.observe(this) { result ->
            when (result) {
                is Result.Success -> {
                    // Navigate to dashboard
                    startActivity(Intent(this, DashboardActivity::class.java))
                    finish()
                }
                is Result.Error -> {
                    Toast.makeText(this, result.message, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private fun validateInputs(username: String, password: String): Boolean {
        // Basic validation
        if (username.isEmpty()) {
            binding.etUsername.error = "Username required"
            return false
        }
        if (password.isEmpty()) {
            binding.etPassword.error = "Password required"
            return false
        }
        return true
    }
}
```

```kotlin
class TransactionHistoryFragment : Fragment() {

        inflater: LayoutInflater,
        container: ViewGroup?,

        return binding.root
    }

        super.onViewCreated(view, savedInstanceState)

        // Initialize ViewModel
        transactionViewModel = ViewModelProvider(this).get(TransactionViewModel::class.java)

        // Setup RecyclerView
        setupRecyclerView()

        // Load transactions
        transactionViewModel.loadTransactions()

        // Observe transactions
        transactionViewModel.transactions.observe(viewLifecycleOwner) { transactions ->
            transactionAdapter.submitList(transactions)
        }
    }

    private fun setupRecyclerView() {
        transactionAdapter = TransactionAdapter()
        binding.rvTransactions.apply {
            layoutManager = LinearLayoutManager(requireContext())
            adapter = transactionAdapter
            addItemDecoration(DividerItemDecoration(requireContext(), DividerItemDecoration.VERTICAL))
        }
    }
}
```

```kotlin
class AccountRepository(private val accountDataSource: AccountDataSource) {

            val account = accountDataSource.getAccountDetails()
            Result.Success(account)
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Result.Error(e.message ?: "Unknown error")
        }
    }

    }
}
```

## 3. Authentication Flow

### 3.1. LoginActivity.kt

```kotlin
class LoginActivity : AppCompatActivity() {
    private lateinit var binding: ActivityLoginBinding
    private lateinit var auth: FirebaseAuth

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        binding = ActivityLoginBinding.inflate(layoutInflater)
        setContentView(binding.root)

        auth = FirebaseAuth.getInstance()

        binding.btnLogin.setOnClickListener {
            val email = binding.etEmail.text.toString().trim()
            val password = binding.etPassword.text.toString().trim()

            if (validateInput(email, password)) {
                loginUser(email, password)
            }
        }

        binding.tvRegister.setOnClickListener {
            startActivity(Intent(this, RegisterActivity::class.java))
        }
    }

    private fun validateInput(email: String, password: String): Boolean {
        if (email.isEmpty()) {
            binding.etEmail.error = "Email is required"
            return false
        }

        if (password.isEmpty()) {
            binding.etPassword.error = "Password is required"
            return false
        }

        return true
    }

    private fun loginUser(email: String, password: String) {
        auth.signInWithEmailAndPassword(email, password)
            .addOnCompleteListener(this) { task ->
                if (task.isSuccessful) {
                    // Login success
                    startActivity(Intent(this, DashboardActivity::class.java))
                    finish()
                } else {
                    // Login failed
                    Toast.makeText(
                        this,
                        "Authentication failed: ${task.exception?.message}",
                        Toast.LENGTH_SHORT
                    ).show()
                }
            }
    }
}
```

### 3.2. RegisterActivity.kt

```kotlin
class RegisterActivity : AppCompatActivity() {
    private lateinit var binding: ActivityRegisterBinding
    private lateinit var auth: FirebaseAuth

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        binding = ActivityRegisterBinding.inflate(layoutInflater)
        setContentView(binding.root)

        auth = FirebaseAuth.getInstance()

        binding.btnRegister.setOnClickListener {
            val name = binding.etName.text.toString().trim()
            val email = binding.etEmail.text.toString().trim()
            val password = binding.etPassword.text.toString().trim()

            if (validateInput(name, email, password)) {
                registerUser(name, email, password)
            }
        }

        binding.tvLogin.setOnClickListener {
            finish()
        }
    }

    private fun validateInput(name: String, email: String, password: String): Boolean {
        if (name.isEmpty()) {
            binding.etName.error = "Name is required"
            return false
        }

        if (email.isEmpty()) {
            binding.etEmail.error = "Email is required"
            return false
        }

        if (password.isEmpty()) {
            binding.etPassword.error = "Password is required"
            return false
        }

        if (password.length < 6) {
            binding.etPassword.error = "Password must be at least 6 characters"
            return false
        }

        return true
    }

    private fun registerUser(name: String, email: String, password: String) {
        auth.createUserWithEmailAndPassword(email, password)
            .addOnCompleteListener(this) { task ->
                if (task.isSuccessful) {
                    // Registration success
                    val user = auth.currentUser
                    val userProfileUpdates = UserProfileChangeRequest.Builder()
                        .setDisplayName(name)
                        .build()

                    user?.updateProfile(userProfileUpdates)
                        ?.addOnCompleteListener { profileTask ->
                            if (profileTask.isSuccessful) {
                                // Profile updated
                                startActivity(Intent(this, DashboardActivity::class.java))
                                finish()
                            }
                        }
                } else {
                    // Registration failed
                    Toast.makeText(
                        this,
                        "Registration failed: ${task.exception?.message}",
                        Toast.LENGTH_SHORT
                    ).show()
                }
            }
    }
}
```

```kotlin
class DashboardActivity : AppCompatActivity() {
    private lateinit var binding: ActivityDashboardBinding
    private lateinit var auth: FirebaseAuth
    private lateinit var firestore: FirebaseFirestore

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        binding = ActivityDashboardBinding.inflate(layoutInflater)
        setContentView(binding.root)

        auth = FirebaseAuth.getInstance()
        firestore = FirebaseFirestore.getInstance()

        setupUI()
        loadUserData()
        setupNavigation()
    }

    private fun setupUI() {
        setSupportActionBar(binding.toolbar)
        supportActionBar?.title = "My Account"

        binding.btnLogout.setOnClickListener {
            auth.signOut()
            startActivity(Intent(this, LoginActivity::class.java))
            finish()
        }
    }

    private fun loadUserData() {
        val user = auth.currentUser
        if (user != null) {
            binding.tvUserName.text = user.displayName ?: "User"
            binding.tvUserEmail.text = user.email

            // Load account balance from Firestore
            firestore.collection("users").document(user.uid)
                .get()
                .addOnSuccessListener { document ->
                    if (document != null) {
                        val balance = document.getDouble("balance") ?: 0.0
                        binding.tvAccountBalance.text = "$${String.format("%.2f", balance)}"
                    }
                }
        }
    }

    private fun setupNavigation() {
        binding.btnTransactions.setOnClickListener {
            // Navigate to transactions screen
        }

        binding.btnTransfer.setOnClickListener {
            // Navigate to transfer screen
        }

        binding.btnPayments.setOnClickListener {
            // Navigate to payments screen
        }
    }
}
```

```kotlin
class LoginActivity : AppCompatActivity() {
    private lateinit var binding: ActivityLoginBinding
    private lateinit var authViewModel: AuthViewModel

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        binding = ActivityLoginBinding.inflate(layoutInflater)
        setContentView(binding.root)

        authViewModel = ViewModelProvider(this).get(AuthViewModel::class.java)

        binding.btnLogin.setOnClickListener {
            val username = binding.etUsername.text.toString()
            val password = binding.etPassword.text.toString()

            authViewModel.login(username, password).observe(this, { result ->
                when (result) {
                    is Result.Success -> {
                        startActivity(Intent(this, DashboardActivity::class.java))
                        finish()
                    }
                    is Result.Error -> {
                        Toast.makeText(this, result.exception.message, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                    }
                }
            })
        }
    }
}
```

**AuthViewModel.kt**

```kotlin
class AuthViewModel(private val authRepository: AuthRepository) : ViewModel() {
    fun login(username: String, password: String): LiveData<Result<User>> {
        val result = MutableLiveData<Result<User>>()
        viewModelScope.launch {
            try {
                val user = authRepository.login(username, password)
                result.value = Result.Success(user)
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                result.value = Result.Error(e)
            }
        }
        return result
    }
}
```

```kotlin
class TransactionActivity : AppCompatActivity() {
    private lateinit var binding: ActivityTransactionBinding
    private lateinit var transactionViewModel: TransactionViewModel

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        binding = ActivityTransactionBinding.inflate(layoutInflater)
        setContentView(binding.root)

        transactionViewModel = ViewModelProvider(this).get(TransactionViewModel::class.java)

        binding.btnSend.setOnClickListener {
            val amount = binding.etAmount.text.toString().toDoubleOrNull()
            val recipient = binding.etRecipient.text.toString()

            if (amount != null && recipient.isNotEmpty()) {
                transactionViewModel.sendMoney(amount, recipient).observe(this, { result ->
                    when (result) {
                        is Result.Success -> {
                            Toast.makeText(this, "Transaction successful", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                            finish()
                        }
                        is Result.Error -> {
                            Toast.makeText(this, result.exception.message, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                        }
                    }
                })
            } else {
                Toast.makeText(this, "Please enter valid amount and recipient", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package com.example.bankingapp.data.repository

import com.example.bankingapp.data.model.Account

class BankingRepository {
    // In a real app, this would connect to a remote API or local database
    private val accounts = mutableListOf<Account>()
    private val transactions = mutableListOf<Transaction>()

    init {
        // Sample data
        accounts.add(Account("1", "123456789", "Checking", 1234.56, "USD"))
        accounts.add(Account("2", "987654321", "Savings", 5678.90, "USD"))

        transactions.add(Transaction("1", Date(), 100.0, "Grocery Store", TransactionType.WITHDRAWAL, "1"))
        transactions.add(Transaction("2", Date(), 50.0, "Salary Deposit", TransactionType.DEPOSIT, "1"))
    }

    fun getAccounts(): List<Account> = accounts

    fun getTransactions(): List<Transaction> = transactions

    fun getAccountById(id: String): Account? = accounts.find { it.id == id }

    fun getTransactionsByAccountId(accountId: String): List<Transaction> =
        transactions.filter { it.accountId == accountId }
}
```

## 4. Database (Room)

### AppDatabase.kt
```kotlin
@Database(
    entities = [Account::class, Transaction::class, User::class],
    version = 1,
    exportSchema = false
)
abstract class AppDatabase : RoomDatabase() {
    abstract fun accountDao(): AccountDao
    abstract fun transactionDao(): TransactionDao
    abstract fun userDao(): UserDao

    companion object {
        @Volatile
        private var INSTANCE: AppDatabase? = null

        fun getDatabase(context: Context): AppDatabase {
            return INSTANCE ?: synchronized(this) {
                val instance = Room.databaseBuilder(
                    context.applicationContext,
                    AppDatabase::class.java,
                    "banking_app_database"
                ).build()
                INSTANCE = instance
                instance
            }
        }
    }
}
```

### AccountDao.kt
```kotlin
@Dao
interface AccountDao {
    @Insert(onConflict = OnConflictStrategy.REPLACE)
    suspend fun insert(account: Account)

    @Query("SELECT * FROM accounts WHERE id = :accountId")
    fun getAccount(accountId: String): LiveData<Account>

    fun getAllAccounts(): LiveData<List<Account>>
}
```

```kotlin
class DashboardFragment : Fragment() {
    private var _binding: FragmentDashboardBinding? = null
    private val binding get() = _binding!!
    private lateinit var accountViewModel: AccountViewModel
    private lateinit var accountAdapter: AccountAdapter

    override fun onCreateView(
        inflater: LayoutInflater,
        container: ViewGroup?,
        savedInstanceState: Bundle?
    ): View {
        _binding = FragmentDashboardBinding.inflate(inflater, container, false)
        return binding.root
    }

    override fun onViewCreated(view: View, savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onViewCreated(view, savedInstanceState)

        // Initialize ViewModel
        accountViewModel = ViewModelProvider(this).get(AccountViewModel::class.java)

        // Setup RecyclerView
        accountAdapter = AccountAdapter()
        binding.rvAccounts.adapter = accountAdapter
        binding.rvAccounts.layoutManager = LinearLayoutManager(requireContext())

        // Observe accounts
        accountViewModel.allAccounts.observe(viewLifecycleOwner) { accounts ->
            accountAdapter.submitList(accounts)

            // Calculate total balance
            val totalBalance = accounts.sumOf { it.balance }
            binding.tvBalance.text = "$${"%.2f".format(totalBalance)}"
        }

        // Sample data (in a real app, this would come from API or database)
        if (accountViewModel.allAccounts.value.isNullOrEmpty()) {
            viewModelScope.launch {
                accountViewModel.insert(
                    Account(
                        id = "1",
                        accountNumber = "****1234",
                        accountType = "Checking",
                        balance = 12345.67,
                        currency = "USD",
                        lastUpdated = "2023-11-15"
                    )
                )
                accountViewModel.insert(
                    Account(
                        id = "2",
                        accountNumber = "****5678",
                        accountType = "Savings",
                        balance = 5678.90,
                        currency = "USD",
                        lastUpdated = "2023-11-15"
                    )
                )
            }
        }
    }

    override fun onDestroyView() {
        super.onDestroyView()
        _binding = null
    }
}
```

## 10. Account Adapter

### AccountAdapter.kt
```kotlin
class AccountAdapter : ListAdapter<Account, AccountAdapter.AccountViewHolder>(AccountDiffCallback()) {

    override fun onCreateViewHolder(parent: ViewGroup, viewType: Int): AccountViewHolder {
        val binding = ItemAccountBinding.inflate(
            LayoutInflater.from(parent.context),
            parent,
            false
        )
        return AccountViewHolder(binding)
    }

    override fun onBindViewHolder(holder: AccountViewHolder, position: Int) {
        val account = getItem(position)
        holder.bind(account)
    }

    class AccountViewHolder(private val binding: ItemAccountBinding) : RecyclerView.ViewHolder(binding.root) {
        fun bind(account: Account) {
            binding.tvAccountNumber.text = account.accountNumber
            binding.tvAccountType.text = account.accountType
            binding.tvBalance.text = "$${"%.2f".format(account.balance)}"
        }
    }

    class AccountDiffCallback : DiffUtil.ItemCallback<Account>() {
        override fun areItemsTheSame(oldItem: Account, newItem: Account): Boolean {
            return oldItem.id == newItem.id
        }

        override fun areContentsTheSame(oldItem: Account, newItem: Account): Boolean {
            return oldItem == newItem
        }
    }
}
```

```kotlin
import android.content.Intent
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity
import android.os.Bundle
import android.widget.Button
import android.widget.EditText
import android.widget.Toast

class LoginActivity : AppCompatActivity() {
    private lateinit var etUsername: EditText
    private lateinit var etPassword: EditText
    private lateinit var btnLogin: Button

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        setContentView(R.layout.activity_login)

        etUsername = findViewById(R.id.etUsername)
        etPassword = findViewById(R.id.etPassword)
        btnLogin = findViewById(R.id.btnLogin)

        btnLogin.setOnClickListener {
            val username = etUsername.text.toString()
            val password = etPassword.text.toString()

            if (validateCredentials(username, password)) {
                // Successful login - navigate to dashboard
                val intent = Intent(this, DashboardActivity::class.java)
                intent.putExtra("USERNAME", username)
                startActivity(intent)
                finish()
            } else {
                Toast.makeText(this, "Invalid credentials", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            }
        }
    }

    private fun validateCredentials(username: String, password: String): Boolean {
        // In a real app, you would validate against a backend service
        return username == "user" && password == "password"
    }
}
```

### Transaction Adapter (`TransactionAdapter.kt`)

```kotlin
import android.view.LayoutInflater
import android.view.View
import android.view.ViewGroup
import android.widget.TextView
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView

class TransactionAdapter(private val transactions: List<Transaction>) :
    RecyclerView.Adapter<TransactionAdapter.TransactionViewHolder>() {

    class TransactionViewHolder(itemView: View) : RecyclerView.ViewHolder(itemView) {
        val tvDescription: TextView = itemView.findViewById(R.id.tvDescription)
        val tvDate: TextView = itemView.findViewById(R.id.tvDate)
        val tvAmount: TextView = itemView.findViewById(R.id.tvAmount)
    }

    override fun onCreateViewHolder(parent: ViewGroup, viewType: Int): TransactionViewHolder {
        val view = LayoutInflater.from(parent.context)
            .inflate(R.layout.item_transaction, parent, false)
        return TransactionViewHolder(view)
    }

    override fun onBindViewHolder(holder: TransactionViewHolder, position: Int) {
        val transaction = transactions[position]
        holder.tvDescription.text = transaction.description
        holder.tvDate.text = transaction.date
        holder.tvAmount.text = "$${transaction.amount}"
    }

    override fun getItemCount(): Int = transactions.size
}
```

```kotlin
// ui/auth/LoginActivity.kt
class LoginActivity : AppCompatActivity() {
    private lateinit var binding: ActivityLoginBinding
    private val viewModel: AuthViewModel by viewModels()

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        binding = ActivityLoginBinding.inflate(layoutInflater)
        setContentView(binding.root)

        setupObservers()
        setupClickListeners()
    }

    private fun setupObservers() {
        viewModel.loginResult.observe(this) { result ->
            result.onSuccess { user ->
                // Navigate to dashboard
                startActivity(Intent(this, DashboardActivity::class.java))
                finish()
            }.onFailure { exception ->
                Toast.makeText(this, exception.message, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            }
        }
    }

    private fun setupClickListeners() {
        binding.btnLogin.setOnClickListener {
            val email = binding.etEmail.text.toString()
            val password = binding.etPassword.text.toString()
            viewModel.login(email, password)
        }

        binding.tvRegister.setOnClickListener {
            startActivity(Intent(this, RegisterActivity::class.java))
        }
    }
}
```

```kotlin
// ui/dashboard/DashboardActivity.kt
class DashboardActivity : AppCompatActivity() {
    private lateinit var binding: ActivityDashboardBinding
    private val viewModel: DashboardViewModel by viewModels()

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        binding = ActivityDashboardBinding.inflate(layoutInflater)
        setContentView(binding.root)

        setupToolbar()
        setupObservers()
        setupClickListeners()
    }

    private fun setupToolbar() {
        setSupportActionBar(binding.toolbar)
        supportActionBar?.title = "My Accounts"
    }

    private fun setupObservers() {
        viewModel.accounts.observe(this) { accounts ->
            binding.rvAccounts.adapter = AccountAdapter(accounts) { account ->
                // Handle account click
                val intent = Intent(this, AccountDetailActivity::class.java).apply {
                    putExtra("ACCOUNT_ID", account.id)
                }
                startActivity(intent)
            }
        }

        viewModel.loading.observe(this) { isLoading ->
            binding.progressBar.visibility = if (isLoading) View.VISIBLE else View.GONE
        }
    }

    private fun setupClickListeners() {
        binding.fabTransfer.setOnClickListener {
            startActivity(Intent(this, TransferActivity::class.java))
        }
    }
}
```

```kotlin
// ui/dashboard/DashboardViewModel.kt
class DashboardViewModel(
    private val repository: BankingRepository
) : ViewModel() {
    private val _accounts = MutableLiveData<List<Account>>()
    val accounts: LiveData<List<Account>> = _accounts

    private val _loading = MutableLiveData<Boolean>()
    val loading: LiveData<Boolean> = _loading

    fun loadAccounts(userId: String) {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            _loading.value = true
            repository.getAccounts(userId).onSuccess { accounts ->
                _accounts.value = accounts
            }.onFailure { exception ->
                // Handle error
            }
            _loading.value = false
        }
    }
}
```

```kotlin
import retrofit2.Retrofit

        }
```

## 6. Security Implementation

### EncryptedSharedPreferences.kt

```kotlin
import android.content.Context
import android.content.SharedPreferences
import androidx.security.crypto.EncryptedSharedPreferences
import androidx.security.crypto.MasterKey

object EncryptedSharedPreferences {
    private const val PREF_FILE_NAME = "secure_prefs"

    fun getInstance(context: Context): SharedPreferences {
        val masterKey = MasterKey.Builder(context)
            .setKeyScheme(MasterKey.KeyScheme.AES256_GCM)
            .build()

        return EncryptedSharedPreferences.create(
            context,
            PREF_FILE_NAME,
            masterKey,
            EncryptedSharedPreferences.PrefKeyEncryptionScheme.AES256_SIV,
            EncryptedSharedPreferences.PrefValueEncryptionScheme.AES256_GCM
        )
    }
}
```

```kotlin
// BankingViewModel.kt
class BankingViewModel(private val repository: BankingRepository) : ViewModel() {
    private val _user = MutableLiveData<User>()
    val user: LiveData<User> = _user

    private val _accounts = MutableLiveData<List<Account>>()
    val accounts: LiveData<List<Account>> = _accounts

    private val _transactions = MutableLiveData<List<Transaction>>()
    val transactions: LiveData<List<Transaction>> = _transactions

    private val _transferResult = MutableLiveData<Boolean>()
    val transferResult: LiveData<Boolean> = _transferResult

    private val _error = MutableLiveData<String>()
    val error: LiveData<String> = _error

    fun loadUserData() {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            try {
                _user.value = repository.getUser()
                _accounts.value = repository.getAccounts()
                _transactions.value = repository.getTransactions()
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                _error.value = e.message ?: "Unknown error occurred"
            }
        }
    }

    fun makeTransfer(amount: Double, recipientAccount: String) {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            try {
                _transferResult.value = repository.makeTransfer(amount, recipientAccount)
                if (_transferResult.value == true) {
                    loadUserData() // Refresh data after transfer
                }
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                _error.value = e.message ?: "Transfer failed"
            }
        }
    }

    // Similar functions for deposit and withdrawal
}
```

```kotlin
        Account("1", "123456789", "Checking", 1500.00, "USD"),
        Account("2", "987654321", "Savings", 5000.00, "USD")
    )

    fun getAccounts(): List<Account> = accounts

    fun getAccountById(id: String): Account? = accounts.find { it.id == id }

    fun transferFunds(fromId: String, toId: String, amount: Double): Boolean {
        val fromAccount = getAccountById(fromId)
        val toAccount = getAccountById(toId)

        if (fromAccount == null || toAccount == null || amount <= 0) return false

        if (fromAccount.balance >= amount) {
            accounts[accounts.indexOf(fromAccount)] = fromAccount.copy(balance = fromAccount.balance - amount)
            accounts[accounts.indexOf(toAccount)] = toAccount.copy(balance = toAccount.balance + amount)
            return true
        }
        return false
    }
```

### b. Repository (BankRepository.kt)

```kotlin
class BankRepository {
    private val accounts = mutableListOf(
        Account("1", "123456789", "Savings", 5000.0, "USD"),
        Account("2", "987654321", "Checking", 2500.0, "USD")
    )

    private val transactions = mutableListOf(
        Transaction("1", "2023-01-15", "Grocery Store", -50.0, "DEBIT"),
        Transaction("2", "2023-01-16", "Salary", 2000.0, "CREDIT"),
        Transaction("3", "2023-01-17", "Electric Bill", -100.0, "DEBIT")
    )

    fun getAccounts(): List<Account> = accounts

    fun getTransactions(accountId: String): List<Transaction> {
        return transactions.filter { it.id == accountId }
    }

    fun transferFunds(fromAccountId: String, toAccountId: String, amount: Double): Boolean {
        val fromAccount = accounts.find { it.id == fromAccountId }
        val toAccount = accounts.find { it.id == toAccountId }

        if (fromAccount != null && toAccount != null && fromAccount.balance >= amount) {
            fromAccount.balance -= amount
            toAccount.balance += amount
            transactions.add(
                Transaction(
                    UUID.randomUUID().toString(),
                    SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd", Locale.getDefault()).format(Date()),
                    "Transfer to ${toAccount.accountNumber}",
                    -amount,
                    "DEBIT"
                )
            )
            transactions.add(
                Transaction(
                    UUID.randomUUID().toString(),
                    SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd", Locale.getDefault()).format(Date()),
                    "Transfer from ${fromAccount.accountNumber}",
                    amount,
                    "CREDIT"
                )
            )
            return true
        }
        return false
    }
}
```

## 5. ViewModel

```kotlin
// BankingViewModel.kt
import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel
import androidx.lifecycle.viewModelScope
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.StateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch

class BankingViewModel : ViewModel() {
    private val _accounts = MutableStateFlow<List<Account>>(emptyList())
    val accounts: StateFlow<List<Account>> = _accounts

    private val _transactions = MutableStateFlow<List<Transaction>>(emptyList())
    val transactions: StateFlow<List<Transaction>> = _transactions

    init {
        loadData()
    }

    private fun loadData() {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            _accounts.value = AccountRepository.getAccounts()
            _transactions.value = AccountRepository.getTransactions()
        }
    }

    fun makeTransfer(amount: Double, fromAccountId: String, toAccountId: String) {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            val fromAccount = AccountRepository.getAccountById(fromAccountId)
            val toAccount = AccountRepository.getAccountById(toAccountId)

            if (fromAccount != null && toAccount != null && fromAccount.balance >= amount) {
                // Update balances
                val updatedFromAccount = fromAccount.copy(balance = fromAccount.balance - amount)
                val updatedToAccount = toAccount.copy(balance = toAccount.balance + amount)

                // In a real app, you would update the repository here
                // For this example, we'll just update the local list
                val updatedAccounts = _accounts.value.map {
                    when (it.id) {
                        fromAccountId -> updatedFromAccount
                        toAccountId -> updatedToAccount
                        else -> it
                    }
                }
                _accounts.value = updatedAccounts

                // Add transaction record
                val transaction = Transaction(
                    id = (_transactions.value.size + 1).toString(),
                    date = java.time.LocalDate.now().toString(),
                    description = "Transfer to ${toAccount.accountNumber}",
                    amount = -amount,
                    type = TransactionType.TRANSFER
                )
                AccountRepository.addTransaction(transaction)
                _transactions.value = AccountRepository.getTransactions()
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```kotlin
// AccountAdapter.kt
import android.view.LayoutInflater
import android.view.ViewGroup
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView
import com.example.bankingapp.databinding.ItemAccountBinding

class AccountAdapter(private var accounts: List<Account>) :
    RecyclerView.Adapter<AccountAdapter.AccountViewHolder>() {

    inner class AccountViewHolder(private val binding: ItemAccountBinding) :
        RecyclerView.ViewHolder(binding.root) {
        fun bind(account: Account) {
            binding.accountNumber.text = "Account: ${account.accountNumber}"
            binding.accountType.text = account.accountType
            binding.accountBalance.text = "${account.currency} ${account.balance}"
        }
    }

    override fun onCreateViewHolder(parent: ViewGroup, viewType: Int): AccountViewHolder {
        val binding = ItemAccountBinding.inflate(
            LayoutInflater.from(parent.context),
            parent,
            false
        )
        return AccountViewHolder(binding)
    }

    override fun onBindViewHolder(holder: AccountViewHolder, position: Int) {
        holder.bind(accounts[position])
    }

    override fun getItemCount(): Int = accounts.size

    fun updateAccounts(newAccounts: List<Account>) {
        accounts = newAccounts
        notifyDataSetChanged()
    }
}
```

```kotlin
    }
```

## 3. Database (AppDatabase.kt)

```kotlin
@Database(entities = [Account::class], version = 1)
abstract class AppDatabase : RoomDatabase() {
    abstract fun accountDao(): AccountDao

    companion object {
        @Volatile
        private var INSTANCE: AppDatabase? = null

        fun getDatabase(context: Context): AppDatabase {
            return INSTANCE ?: synchronized(this) {
                val instance = Room.databaseBuilder(
                    context.applicationContext,
                    AppDatabase::class.java,
                    "banking_app_db"
                ).build()
                INSTANCE = instance
                instance
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```kotlin

    @Insert
    suspend fun insert(account: Account)

    @Update
    suspend fun update(account: Account)

    @Query("SELECT * FROM accounts WHERE id = :id")
    suspend fun getAccountById(id: Int): Account?

    @Query("SELECT * FROM accounts")
    fun getAllAccounts(): LiveData<List<Account>>
}
```

## 5. Repository (AccountRepository.kt)

```kotlin
class AccountRepository(private val accountDao: AccountDao) {
    val allAccounts: LiveData<List<Account>> = accountDao.getAllAccounts()

    suspend fun insert(account: Account) {
        accountDao.insert(account)
    }

    suspend fun update(account: Account) {
        accountDao.update(account)
    }

    suspend fun getAccountById(id: Int): Account? {
        return accountDao.getAccountById(id)
    }
}
```

## 6. ViewModel (AccountViewModel.kt)

```kotlin
class AccountViewModel(application: Application) : AndroidViewModel(application) {
    private val repository: AccountRepository
    val allAccounts: LiveData<List<Account>>

    init {
        val accountDao = AppDatabase.getDatabase(application).accountDao()
        repository = AccountRepository(accountDao)
        allAccounts = repository.allAccounts
    }

    fun insert(account: Account) = viewModelScope.launch {
        repository.insert(account)
    }

    fun update(account: Account) = viewModelScope.launch {
        repository.update(account)
    }

    fun getAccountById(id: Int): LiveData<Account?> {
        val result = MutableLiveData<Account?>()
        viewModelScope.launch {
            result.postValue(repository.getAccountById(id))
        }
        return result
    }
}
```

## 7. Main Activity (MainActivity.kt)

```kotlin
class MainActivity : AppCompatActivity() {
    private lateinit var accountViewModel: AccountViewModel
    private lateinit var binding: ActivityMainBinding

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        binding = ActivityMainBinding.inflate(layoutInflater)
        setContentView(binding.root)

        accountViewModel = ViewModelProvider(this).get(AccountViewModel::class.java)

        // Setup RecyclerView
        val adapter = AccountAdapter()
        binding.recyclerView.layoutManager = LinearLayoutManager(this)
        binding.recyclerView.adapter = adapter

        // Observe accounts
        accountViewModel.allAccounts.observe(this) { accounts ->
            accounts?.let { adapter.submitList(it) }
        }

        // Add sample data if empty
        if (accountViewModel.allAccounts.value.isNullOrEmpty()) {
            addSampleAccounts()
        }

        // Setup FAB
        binding.fab.setOnClickListener {
            showAddAccountDialog()
        }
    }

    private fun addSampleAccounts() {
        val sampleAccounts = listOf(
            Account(accountNumber = "123456789", accountHolderName = "John Doe", balance = 1500.0, accountType = "Checking"),
            Account(accountNumber = "987654321", accountHolderName = "John Doe", balance = 5000.0, accountType = "Savings")
        )

        sampleAccounts.forEach { account ->
            accountViewModel.insert(account)
        }
    }

    private fun showAddAccountDialog() {
        val dialogView = LayoutInflater.from(this).inflate(R.layout.dialog_add_account, null)
        val dialog = AlertDialog.Builder(this)
            .setTitle("Add New Account")
            .setView(dialogView)
            .setPositiveButton("Add") { _, _ ->
                val accountNumber = dialogView.findViewById<EditText>(R.id.etAccountNumber).text.toString()
                val accountHolder = dialogView.findViewById<EditText>(R.id.etAccountHolder).text.toString()
                val balance = dialogView.findViewById<EditText>(R.id.etBalance).text.toString().toDoubleOrNull() ?: 0.0
                val accountType = dialogView.findViewById<Spinner>(R.id.spinnerAccountType).selectedItem.toString()

                val newAccount = Account(
                    accountNumber = accountNumber,
                    accountHolderName = accountHolder,
                    balance = balance,
                    accountType = accountType
                )

                accountViewModel.insert(newAccount)
            }
            .setNegativeButton("Cancel", null)
            .create()

        dialog.show()
    }
}
```

## 8. Adapter (AccountAdapter.kt)

```kotlin
class AccountAdapter : ListAdapter<Account, AccountAdapter.AccountViewHolder>(AccountDiffCallback()) {

    override fun onCreateViewHolder(parent: ViewGroup, viewType: Int): AccountViewHolder {
        val view = LayoutInflater.from(parent.context)
            .inflate(R.layout.item_account, parent, false)
        return AccountViewHolder(view)
    }

    override fun onBindViewHolder(holder: AccountViewHolder, position: Int) {
        val account = getItem(position)
        holder.bind(account)
    }

    class AccountViewHolder(itemView: View) : RecyclerView.ViewHolder(itemView) {
        private val tvAccountNumber: TextView = itemView.findViewById(R.id.tvAccountNumber)
        private val tvAccountHolder: TextView = itemView.findViewById(R.id.tvAccountHolder)
        private val tvBalance: TextView = itemView.findViewById(R.id.tvBalance)
        private val tvAccountType: TextView = itemView.findViewById(R.id.tvAccountType)

        fun bind(account: Account) {
            tvAccountNumber.text = "Account: ${account.accountNumber}"
            tvAccountHolder.text = account.accountHolderName
            tvBalance.text = "Balance: $${"%.2f".format(account.balance)}"
            tvAccountType.text = account.accountType
        }
    }

    class AccountDiffCallback : DiffUtil.ItemCallback<Account>() {
        override fun areItemsTheSame(oldItem: Account, newItem: Account): Boolean {
            return oldItem.id == newItem.id
        }

        override fun areContentsTheSame(oldItem: Account, newItem: Account): Boolean {
            return oldItem == newItem
        }
    }
}
```

   - Retrofit for API calls

```kotlin
data class BankAccount(
    val id: String,
    val accountNumber: String,
    val accountType: String,
    val balance: Double,
    val currency: String,
    val transactions: List<Transaction>
)

data class Transaction(
```

### b. Repository (BankRepository.kt)

```kotlin
class BankRepository(private val apiService: BankApiService) {

    suspend fun getAccounts(): List<BankAccount> {
        return apiService.getAccounts()
    }

    suspend fun getAccountDetails(accountId: String): BankAccount {
        return apiService.getAccountDetails(accountId)
    }

    suspend fun transferFunds(
        fromAccountId: String,
        toAccountId: String,
        amount: Double
    ): Boolean {
        return apiService.transferFunds(
            TransferRequest(fromAccountId, toAccountId, amount)
        )
    }
}

data class TransferRequest(
    val fromAccountId: String,
    val toAccountId: String,
    val amount: Double
)
```

### c. API Service (BankApiService.kt)

```kotlin
interface BankApiService {
    @GET("accounts")
    suspend fun getAccounts(): List<BankAccount>

    @GET("accounts/{accountId}")
    suspend fun getAccountDetails(@Path("accountId") accountId: String): BankAccount

    @POST("transfers")
    suspend fun transferFunds(@Body request: TransferRequest): Boolean
}
```

### d. ViewModel (BankViewModel.kt)

```kotlin
class BankViewModel(private val repository: BankRepository) : ViewModel() {
    private val _accounts = MutableLiveData<List<BankAccount>>()
    val accounts: LiveData<List<BankAccount>> = _accounts

    private val _accountDetails = MutableLiveData<BankAccount>()
    val accountDetails: LiveData<BankAccount> = _accountDetails

    private val _transferResult = MutableLiveData<Boolean>()
    val transferResult: LiveData<Boolean> = _transferResult

    fun loadAccounts() {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            try {
                _accounts.value = repository.getAccounts()
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                // Handle error
            }
        }
    }

    fun loadAccountDetails(accountId: String) {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            try {
                _accountDetails.value = repository.getAccountDetails(accountId)
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                // Handle error
            }
        }
    }

    fun transferFunds(fromAccountId: String, toAccountId: String, amount: Double) {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            try {
                _transferResult.value = repository.transferFunds(fromAccountId, toAccountId, amount)
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                _transferResult.value = false
            }
        }
    }
}
```

### c. Transfer Fragment (TransferFragment.kt)

```kotlin
class TransferFragment : Fragment() {
    private lateinit var binding: FragmentTransferBinding
    private val viewModel: BankViewModel by activityViewModels()

    override fun onCreateView(
        inflater: LayoutInflater,
        container: ViewGroup?,
        savedInstanceState: Bundle?
    ): View {
        binding = FragmentTransferBinding.inflate(inflater, container, false)
        return binding.root
    }

    override fun onViewCreated(view: View, savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onViewCreated(view, savedInstanceState)

        binding.transferButton.setOnClickListener {
            val fromAccountId = binding.fromAccountId.text.toString()
            val toAccountId = binding.toAccountId.text.toString()
            val amount = binding.amount.text.toString().toDoubleOrNull() ?: 0.0

            if (fromAccountId.isNotEmpty() && toAccountId.isNotEmpty() && amount > 0) {
                viewModel.transferFunds(fromAccountId, toAccountId, amount)
            } else {
                Toast.makeText(context, "Please fill all fields correctly", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            }
        }

        viewModel.transferResult.observe(viewLifecycleOwner) { success ->
            if (success) {
                Toast.makeText(context, "Transfer successful", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                findNavController().popBackStack()
            } else {
                Toast.makeText(context, "Transfer failed", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```kotlin
class AccountAdapter(private val onClick: (BankAccount) -> Unit) :
    ListAdapter<BankAccount, AccountAdapter.AccountViewHolder>(AccountDiffCallback()) {

    override fun onCreateViewHolder(parent: ViewGroup, viewType: Int): AccountViewHolder {
        val view = LayoutInflater.from(parent.context)
            .inflate(R.layout.item_account, parent, false)
        return AccountViewHolder(view)
    }

    override fun onBindViewHolder(holder: AccountViewHolder, position: Int) {
        val account = getItem(position)
        holder.bind(account, onClick)
    }

    class AccountViewHolder(itemView: View) : RecyclerView.ViewHolder(itemView) {
        private val accountNumber: TextView = itemView.findViewById(R.id.accountNumber)
        private val accountType: TextView = itemView.findViewById(R.id.accountType)
        private val balance: TextView = itemView.findViewById(R.id.balance)

        fun bind(account: BankAccount, onClick: (BankAccount) -> Unit) {
            accountNumber.text = account.accountNumber
            accountType.text = account.accountType
            balance.text = "${account.currency} ${account.balance}"

            itemView.setOnClickListener { onClick(account) }
        }
    }
}

class AccountDiffCallback : DiffUtil.ItemCallback<BankAccount>() {
    override fun areItemsTheSame(oldItem: BankAccount, newItem: BankAccount): Boolean {
        return oldItem.id == newItem.id
    }

    override fun areContentsTheSame(oldItem: BankAccount, newItem: BankAccount): Boolean {
        return oldItem == newItem
    }
}
```

Create a simple data model for accounts:

```kotlin
// Account.kt

    val id: String,
    val accountNumber: String,
    val accountType: String,
    val balance: Double,
    val currency: String
)

data class Transaction(
    val id: String,
    val date: String,
    val description: String,
    val amount: Double,
    val type: String // "credit" or "debit"
```

## 3. Repository (Mock Implementation)

```kotlin
// BankingRepository.kt
class BankingRepository {
    private val accounts = mutableListOf(
        Account("1", "123456789", "Checking", 1500.0, "USD"),
        Account("2", "987654321", "Savings", 5000.0, "USD")
    )

    private val transactions = mutableListOf(
        Transaction("1", "2023-01-15", "Grocery Store", -50.0, "debit"),
        Transaction("2", "2023-01-16", "Salary Deposit", 2000.0, "credit"),
        Transaction("3", "2023-01-17", "Electric Bill", -100.0, "debit")
    )

    fun getAccounts(): List<Account> = accounts

    fun getTransactions(accountId: String): List<Transaction> {
        return transactions.filter { it.id.startsWith(accountId) }
    }

    fun transferFunds(fromAccountId: String, toAccountId: String, amount: Double): Boolean {
        val fromAccount = accounts.find { it.id == fromAccountId } ?: return false
        val toAccount = accounts.find { it.id == toAccountId } ?: return false

        if (fromAccount.balance < amount) return false

        accounts[accounts.indexOf(fromAccount)] = fromAccount.copy(balance = fromAccount.balance - amount)
        accounts[accounts.indexOf(toAccount)] = toAccount.copy(balance = toAccount.balance + amount)

        transactions.add(
            Transaction(
                id = "${fromAccountId}-${System.currentTimeMillis()}",
                date = "2023-01-20",
                description = "Transfer to ${toAccount.accountNumber}",
                amount = -amount,
                type = "debit"
            )
        )

        transactions.add(
            Transaction(
                id = "${toAccountId}-${System.currentTimeMillis()}",
                date = "2023-01-20",
                description = "Transfer from ${fromAccount.accountNumber}",
                amount = amount,
                type = "credit"
            )
        )

        return true
    }
}
```

### Transfer Activity

```kotlin
// TransferActivity.kt
class TransferActivity : AppCompatActivity() {
    private lateinit var viewModel: BankingViewModel
    private lateinit var binding: ActivityTransferBinding

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        binding = ActivityTransferBinding.inflate(layoutInflater)
        setContentView(binding.root)

        viewModel = ViewModelProvider(this).get(BankingViewModel::class.java)

        setupUI()
        setupObservers()
        viewModel.loadAccounts()
    }

    private fun setupUI() {
        binding.btnTransfer.setOnClickListener {
            val fromAccountId = binding.spFromAccount.selectedItem.toString()
            val toAccountId = binding.spToAccount.selectedItem.toString()
            val amount = binding.etAmount.text.toString().toDoubleOrNull() ?: 0.0

            viewModel.transferFunds(fromAccountId, toAccountId, amount)
        }
    }

    private fun setupObservers() {
        viewModel.accounts.observe(this) { accounts ->
            setupAccountSpinners(accounts)
        }

        viewModel.transferResult.observe(this) { success ->
            if (success) {
                Toast.makeText(this, "Transfer successful", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                finish()
            } else {
                Toast.makeText(this, "Transfer failed", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            }
        }
    }

    private fun setupAccountSpinners(accounts: List<Account>) {
        val accountIds = accounts.map { it.id }.toTypedArray()
        val adapter = ArrayAdapter(this, android.R.layout.simple_spinner_item, accountIds)
        adapter.setDropDownViewResource(android.R.layout.simple_spinner_dropdown_item)

        binding.spFromAccount.adapter = adapter
        binding.spToAccount.adapter = adapter
    }
}
```

## 8. Adapter (AccountAdapter.kt)

```kotlin
class AccountAdapter : ListAdapter<Account, AccountAdapter.AccountViewHolder>(AccountDiffCallback()) {

    override fun onCreateViewHolder(parent: ViewGroup, viewType: Int): AccountViewHolder {
        val view = LayoutInflater.from(parent.context)
            .inflate(R.layout.item_account, parent, false)
        return AccountViewHolder(view)
    }

    override fun onBindViewHolder(holder: AccountViewHolder, position: Int) {
        val account = getItem(position)
        holder.bind(account)
    }

    class AccountViewHolder(itemView: View) : RecyclerView.ViewHolder(itemView) {
        private val accountNumber: TextView = itemView.findViewById(R.id.accountNumber)
        private val accountType: TextView = itemView.findViewById(R.id.accountType)
        private val balance: TextView = itemView.findViewById(R.id.balance)

        fun bind(account: Account) {
            accountNumber.text = account.accountNumber
            accountType.text = account.accountType
            balance.text = "${account.balance} ${account.currency}"
        }
    }

    class AccountDiffCallback : DiffUtil.ItemCallback<Account>() {
        override fun areItemsTheSame(oldItem: Account, newItem: Account): Boolean {
            return oldItem.id == newItem.id
        }

        override fun areContentsTheSame(oldItem: Account, newItem: Account): Boolean {
            return oldItem == newItem
        }
    }
}
```

```kotlin
class AccountAdapter(private val onClick: (Account) -> Unit) :
    ListAdapter<Account, AccountAdapter.AccountViewHolder>(AccountDiffCallback()) {

    override fun onCreateViewHolder(parent: ViewGroup, viewType: Int): AccountViewHolder {
        val view = LayoutInflater.from(parent.context)
            .inflate(R.layout.item_account, parent, false)
        return AccountViewHolder(view)
    }

    override fun onBindViewHolder(holder: AccountViewHolder, position: Int) {
        val account = getItem(position)
        holder.bind(account, onClick)
    }

    class AccountViewHolder(itemView: View) : RecyclerView.ViewHolder(itemView) {
        private val accountName: TextView = itemView.findViewById(R.id.accountName)
        private val accountNumber: TextView = itemView.findViewById(R.id.accountNumber)
        private val balance: TextView = itemView.findViewById(R.id.balance)

        fun bind(account: Account, onClick: (Account) -> Unit) {
            accountName.text = account.accountName
            accountNumber.text = "•••• ${account.accountNumber.takeLast(4)}"
            balance.text = String.format("$%.2f", account.balance)

            itemView.setOnClickListener { onClick(account) }
        }
    }

    class AccountDiffCallback : DiffUtil.ItemCallback<Account>() {
        override fun areItemsTheSame(oldItem: Account, newItem: Account): Boolean {
            return oldItem.id == newItem.id
        }

        override fun areContentsTheSame(oldItem: Account, newItem: Account): Boolean {
            return oldItem == newItem
        }
    }
}
```

## 9. Account Detail Activity (AccountDetailActivity.kt)

```kotlin
class AccountDetailActivity : AppCompatActivity() {
    private lateinit var accountViewModel: AccountViewModel
    private var accountId: Int = -1

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        setContentView(R.layout.activity_account_detail)

        accountId = intent.getIntExtra("ACCOUNT_ID", -1)
        accountViewModel = ViewModelProvider(this).get(AccountViewModel::class.java)

        val accountName = findViewById<TextView>(R.id.accountName)
        val accountNumber = findViewById<TextView>(R.id.accountNumber)
        val balance = findViewById<TextView>(R.id.balance)
        val transferButton = findViewById<Button>(R.id.transferButton)

        accountViewModel.getAccountById(accountId).observe(this, { account ->
            account?.let {
                accountName.text = it.accountName
                accountNumber.text = it.accountNumber
                balance.text = String.format("$%.2f", it.balance)
            }
        })

        transferButton.setOnClickListener {
            showTransferDialog()
        }
    }

    private fun showTransferDialog() {
        val dialogView = LayoutInflater.from(this).inflate(R.layout.dialog_transfer, null)
        val amount = dialogView.findViewById<EditText>(R.id.transferAmount)
        val recipient = dialogView.findViewById<EditText>(R.id.recipientAccount)

        AlertDialog.Builder(this)
            .setTitle("Transfer Funds")
            .setView(dialogView)
            .setPositiveButton("Transfer") { _, _ ->
                val transferAmount = amount.text.toString().toDoubleOrNull() ?: 0.0
                if (transferAmount > 0) {
                    performTransfer(transferAmount)
                }
            }
            .setNegativeButton("Cancel", null)
            .show()
    }

    private fun performTransfer(amount: Double) {
        accountViewModel.getAccountById(accountId).observe(this, { account ->
            account?.let {
                val newBalance = it.balance - amount
                if (newBalance >= 0) {
                    val updatedAccount = it.copy(balance = newBalance)
                    accountViewModel.update(updatedAccount)
                    Toast.makeText(this, "Transfer successful", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                } else {
                    Toast.makeText(this, "Insufficient funds", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                }
            }
        })
    }
}
```

### b. Repository (BankRepository.kt)

```kotlin
class BankRepository {
    private val accounts = mutableListOf(
        BankAccount(
            id = "1",
            accountNumber = "****1234",
            accountType = "Savings",
            balance = 5000.00,
            currency = "USD",
            transactions = listOf(
                Transaction(
                    id = "t1",
                    date = "2023-10-01",
                    description = "ATM Withdrawal",
                    amount = 200.00,
                    type = "DEBIT"
                ),
                Transaction(
                    id = "t2",
                    date = "2023-10-02",
                    description = "Salary Deposit",
                    amount = 3000.00,
                    type = "CREDIT"
                )
            )
        )
    )

    fun getAccounts(): List<BankAccount> = accounts

    fun getAccount(accountId: String): BankAccount? {
        return accounts.find { it.id == accountId }
    }

    fun transferFunds(fromAccountId: String, toAccountId: String, amount: Double): Boolean {
        // In a real app, this would be a network call
        val fromAccount = accounts.find { it.id == fromAccountId }
        val toAccount = accounts.find { it.id == toAccountId }

        if (fromAccount != null && toAccount != null && fromAccount.balance >= amount) {
            fromAccount.balance -= amount
            toAccount.balance += amount
            return true
        }
        return false
    }
}
```

```kotlin
        _accounts.value = repository.getAccounts()
    }

    fun selectAccount(accountId: String) {
        _selectedAccount.value = repository.getAccount(accountId)
    }

    fun transferFunds(fromAccountId: String, toAccountId: String, amount: Double): Boolean {
        return repository.transferFunds(fromAccountId, toAccountId, amount)
```

```kotlin
class AccountListFragment : Fragment() {
    private lateinit var binding: FragmentAccountListBinding
    private val viewModel: BankViewModel by activityViewModels()

    override fun onCreateView(
        inflater: LayoutInflater,
        container: ViewGroup?,
        savedInstanceState: Bundle?
    ): View {
        binding = FragmentAccountListBinding.inflate(inflater, container, false)
        return binding.root
    }

    override fun onViewCreated(view: View, savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onViewCreated(view, savedInstanceState)

        val adapter = AccountAdapter { accountId ->
            viewModel.selectAccount(accountId)
            findNavController().navigate(R.id.action_accountListFragment_to_accountDetailFragment)
        }

        binding.recyclerView.layoutManager = LinearLayoutManager(requireContext())
        binding.recyclerView.adapter = adapter

        viewModel.accounts.observe(viewLifecycleOwner) { accounts ->
            adapter.submitList(accounts)
        }
    }
}

class AccountAdapter(private val onClick: (String) -> Unit) :
    ListAdapter<BankAccount, AccountAdapter.AccountViewHolder>(AccountDiffCallback()) {

    override fun onCreateViewHolder(parent: ViewGroup, viewType: Int): AccountViewHolder {
        val binding = ItemAccountBinding.inflate(
            LayoutInflater.from(parent.context),
            parent,
            false
        )
        return AccountViewHolder(binding)
    }

    override fun onBindViewHolder(holder: AccountViewHolder, position: Int) {
        val account = getItem(position)
        holder.bind(account)
        holder.itemView.setOnClickListener { onClick(account.id) }
    }

    class AccountViewHolder(private val binding: ItemAccountBinding) :
        RecyclerView.ViewHolder(binding.root) {
        fun bind(account: BankAccount) {
            binding.accountNumber.text = account.accountNumber
            binding.accountType.text = account.accountType
            binding.balance.text = "${account.currency} ${"%.2f".format(account.balance)}"
        }
    }
}

class AccountDiffCallback : DiffUtil.ItemCallback<BankAccount>() {
    override fun areItemsTheSame(oldItem: BankAccount, newItem: BankAccount): Boolean {
        return oldItem.id == newItem.id
    }

    override fun areContentsTheSame(oldItem: BankAccount, newItem: BankAccount): Boolean {
        return oldItem == newItem
    }
}
```

### b. Account Detail Fragment (AccountDetailFragment.kt)

```kotlin
class AccountDetailFragment : Fragment() {
    private lateinit var binding: FragmentAccountDetailBinding
    private val viewModel: BankViewModel by activityViewModels()

    override fun onCreateView(
        inflater: LayoutInflater,
        container: ViewGroup?,
        savedInstanceState: Bundle?
    ): View {
        binding = FragmentAccountDetailBinding.inflate(inflater, container, false)
        return binding.root
    }

    override fun onViewCreated(view: View, savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onViewCreated(view, savedInstanceState)

        val transactionAdapter = TransactionAdapter()
        binding.transactionsRecyclerView.layoutManager = LinearLayoutManager(requireContext())
        binding.transactionsRecyclerView.adapter = transactionAdapter

        viewModel.selectedAccount.observe(viewLifecycleOwner) { account ->
            account?.let {
                binding.accountNumber.text = it.accountNumber
                binding.accountType.text = it.accountType
                binding.balance.text = "${it.currency} ${"%.2f".format(it.balance)}"
                transactionAdapter.submitList(it.transactions)
            }
        }

        binding.transferButton.setOnClickListener {
            showTransferDialog()
        }
    }

    private fun showTransferDialog() {
        val dialogView = LayoutInflater.from(requireContext()).inflate(R.layout.dialog_transfer, null)
        val dialog = AlertDialog.Builder(requireContext())
            .setTitle("Transfer Funds")
            .setView(dialogView)
            .setPositiveButton("Transfer") { _, _ ->
                // Handle transfer
            }
            .setNegativeButton("Cancel", null)
            .create()

        dialog.show()
    }
}

class TransactionAdapter :
    ListAdapter<Transaction, TransactionAdapter.TransactionViewHolder>(TransactionDiffCallback()) {

    override fun onCreateViewHolder(parent: ViewGroup, viewType: Int): TransactionViewHolder {
        val binding = ItemTransactionBinding.inflate(
            LayoutInflater.from(parent.context),
            parent,
            false
        )
        return TransactionViewHolder(binding)
    }

    override fun onBindViewHolder(holder: TransactionViewHolder, position: Int) {
        val transaction = getItem(position)
        holder.bind(transaction)
    }

    class TransactionViewHolder(private val binding: ItemTransactionBinding) :
        RecyclerView.ViewHolder(binding.root) {
        fun bind(transaction: Transaction) {
            binding.date.text = transaction.date
            binding.description.text = transaction.description
            binding.amount.text = "${transaction.amount}"
            binding.amount.setTextColor(
                if (transaction.type == "DEBIT") Color.RED else Color.GREEN
            )
        }
    }
}

class TransactionDiffCallback : DiffUtil.ItemCallback<Transaction>() {
    override fun areItemsTheSame(oldItem: Transaction, newItem: Transaction): Boolean {
        return oldItem.id == newItem.id
    }

    override fun areContentsTheSame(oldItem: Transaction, newItem: Transaction): Boolean {
        return oldItem == newItem
    }
}
```

4. **Navigation**: Between account list and detail screens
5. **Data Binding**: For UI components
6. **ViewModel**: For managing UI-related data
7. **Repository Pattern**: For data access

This is a minimal but functional banking app that demonstrates core Android development patterns. In a production app, you would want to add:
- Proper error handling
- Network calls to a real backend
- Authentication
- More robust data persistence
- Security measures
- More comprehensive UI/UX features

```kotlin
import android.os.Bundle
import android.view.LayoutInflater
import android.view.View
import android.view.ViewGroup
import androidx.fragment.app.Fragment
import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModelProvider
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.LinearLayoutManager
import com.example.banking.databinding.FragmentTransactionsBinding

class TransactionsFragment : Fragment() {
    private var _binding: FragmentTransactionsBinding? = null
    private val binding get() = _binding!!

    override fun onCreateView(
        inflater: LayoutInflater,
        container: ViewGroup?,
        savedInstanceState: Bundle?
    ): View {
        val transactionsViewModel = ViewModelProvider(this).get(TransactionsViewModel::class.java)
        _binding = FragmentTransactionsBinding.inflate(inflater, container, false)
        val root: View = binding.root

        val adapter = TransactionsAdapter()
        binding.transactionsRecyclerView.layoutManager = LinearLayoutManager(context)
        binding.transactionsRecyclerView.adapter = adapter

        transactionsViewModel.transactions.observe(viewLifecycleOwner) { transactions ->
            adapter.submitList(transactions)
```

## 3. Repository (Mock Implementation)

```kotlin
// AccountRepository.kt
class AccountRepository {
    private val accounts = mutableListOf(
        Account("1", "123456789", 1500.0, "Checking", "USD"),
        Account("2", "987654321", 5000.0, "Savings", "USD")
    )

    fun getAccounts(): List<Account> = accounts

    fun getAccountById(id: String): Account? = accounts.find { it.id == id }

    fun transferFunds(fromAccountId: String, toAccountId: String, amount: Double): Boolean {
        val fromAccount = getAccountById(fromAccountId) ?: return false
        val toAccount = getAccountById(toAccountId) ?: return false

        if (fromAccount.balance < amount) return false

        accounts.removeAll { it.id == fromAccountId || it.id == toAccountId }

        accounts.add(fromAccount.copy(balance = fromAccount.balance - amount))
        accounts.add(toAccount.copy(balance = toAccount.balance + amount))

        return true
    }
}
```

```kotlin
class AccountViewModel : ViewModel() {

    private val _transferResult = MutableLiveData<Boolean>()
    val transferResult: LiveData<Boolean> = _transferResult

    init {

    }

    fun loadAccounts() {
        _accounts.value = repository.getAccounts()
    }

    fun transferFunds(fromAccountId: String, toAccountId: String, amount: Double) {
        _transferResult.value = repository.transferFunds(fromAccountId, toAccountId, amount)
```

```kotlin
            val amount = binding.amount.text.toString().toDoubleOrNull() ?: 0.0
```

```kotlin
        accountNumber = "1234567890",
        accountHolder = "John Doe",

        transactions = listOf(
            Transaction(
                id = "txn1",
                date = "2023-10-01",

                type = TransactionType.DEPOSIT,
                description = "Salary deposit"
            ),
            Transaction(

                description = "Grocery shopping"
```
